oṃ
namo gaṇeśāya
1 ārādhya nandanandanam anusaṃdhāya prayatnato granthān |
śrīvācaspativibudho vyavahṛticintāmaṇiṃ tanute ||
2 māṣottarakriyāpādā nirṇayaḥ sopadeśakaḥ |
catuṣpāt tattvaviṣayo vyavahāro nirūpyate ||
tatrādāv upadeśe varṇanīye tanmūlavyavahārasamayam āha nāradaḥ |
3 dharmaikatānāḥ puruṣā yadāsan satyavādinaḥ |
tadā na vyavahāro 'bhūn na dveṣo na ca matsaraḥ || [NMā 1.1]
4 naṣṭe dharme manuṣyāṇāṃ vyavahāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
draṣṭā ca vyavahārāṇāṃ rājā daṇḍadharaḥ svayam || [NMā 1.2]
vyavahāro vivādaḥ | naṣṭe dharme kaliyuge | daṇḍadhara ity anenoddhataśāsakatvam uktam |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
5 yo daṇḍyān daṇḍayed rājā samyag vadhyāṃś ca ghātayet |
iṣṭaṃ syāt kratubhis tena sahasraśatadakṣiṇaiḥ || [Y 1.359]
samyak yathāśastram |
6 iti saṃcintya nṛpatiḥ kratutulyaphalaṃ pṛthak |
vyavahārān svayaṃ paśyet sabhyaiḥ parivṛto 'nvaham || [Y 1.360]
kātyāyanaḥ |
7 vinītaveśo nṛpatiḥ sabhāṃ gatvā samāhitaḥ |
āsīnaḥ prāṅmukho bhūtvā paśyet kāryāṇi kāryiṇām || [K 55]
8 sa tu sabhyaiḥ sthirair yuktaḥ prajñāmūlair dvijottamaiḥ |
dharmaśāstrārthakuśalair arthaśāstraviśāradaiḥ |
9 saprāḍvivākaḥ sāmātyaḥ sabrāḥmaṇapurohitaḥ |
sasabhyaḥ prakṣako rājā svarge tiṣṭhati dharmataḥ || [K 56]
vinīteti – tathā cānuddhatavegasya rājño darśane vādino na kṣubhyantīty ataḥ samyagbhāṣādisiddhau tattvanirūpaṇaṃ sukaraṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | āsīnatvaprāṅmukatve 'dṛṣṭārthe | sthirair dharmaviniścalacittaiḥ | dharmaśāstreti – tathā ca dharmaśāstrārthaśāstrayor avirodham āśritya vicāraṇīyam | virodhe tu dharmaśāstroktam eva grāhyam | tad uktaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
10 smṛtyarthayor virodhe tu arthaśāstrasya bādhanam |
parasparavirodhe tu nyāyayuktaṃ pramāṇavat ||
smṛtir dharmaśāstraṃ manvādisaṃhitā | artho 'rthaśāstraṃ daṇḍanītyādi | dharmaśāstrayor eva tu parasparavirodhe viṣayabhedādināpy asamādheye niryuktikaṃ bādhyata ity arthaḥ | nārado 'py āha |
11 dharmaśāstravirodhe tu yuktiyukto vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
vyavahāro hi balavān dharmas tenāvahīyate || [N Mā 1.40]
vyavahāro yuktiḥ | prāḍvivāko vakṣyate | prekṣakaḥ samyagvicārako rājā vicārajanitāt puṇyāt tair vicārasahāyaiḥ saha svarge tiṣṭhatīty arthaḥ |
nāradaḥ |
12 rājā dharmasahāyas tu dvayor vivadamānayoḥ |
samyak kāryāṇy avekṣeta rāgadveṣavivarjitaḥ || [NQ 1.4]
13 dharmeṇōddharato rājño vyavahārān kṛtātmanaḥ |
sambhavanti guṇāḥ sapta sapta vahner ivārciṣaḥ || [NMā 1.32]
14 dharmaś cārthaś c kīrtiś ca lokapaktir upagrahaḥ |
prajābhyo bahumānaś ca svarge sthānaṃ ca śāśvatam || [NMā 1.33]
15 tasmād dharmāsanaṃ prāpya rājā vigatamatsaraḥ |
samaḥ syāt sarvabhūteṣu bibhrad vaivasvataṃ vratam || [NMā 1.34]
uddharataḥ samyaṅ nirṇayataḥ | lokapaktiḥ lokaiḥ stotavyatā | upagraho 'nuvartanīyatvam | vaivasvataṃ vrataṃ sarvabhūtasamatvam | yamaḥ |
16 śrutismṛtiviruddhaṃ ca bhūtānām ahitaṃ ca yat |
na tat pravartayed rājā pravṛttaṃ ca nivartayet ||
17 nyāyāpetaṃ yad anyena rājñājñānakṛtaṃ bhavet |
tad apy āmnāyavihite punar nyāye niveśayet ||
āmnāyo vedaḥ |
svayaṃ ca vyavahāradarśanāśaktau tatkṣamo dhārmiko brāhmaṇo niyojyaḥ | tad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
18 yadā kāryavaśād rājā na paśyet kāryanirṇayam |
tadā niyuñjyād vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam || [K 63]
19 dāntaṃ kulīnaṃ madhyastham anudvegakaraṃ sthiram |
paratra bhīruṃ dharmiṣṭham udyuktaṃ krodhavarjitam || [K 64]
kāryavaśād rājakāryāntaravaśāt | kāryanirṇayaṃ bhāṣottarādikam | vidvāṃsaṃ vedāviruddhatarkakṣuṇṇamatim | vedapāragaṃ pariśīlitadharmaśāstram | dāntaṃ tapaḥkleśasaham | kulīnaṃ saṃkarādidoṣaśūnyaṃ mātāpitṛpamparākam | madhyasthaṃ sarvatra samadṛṣṭim | anudvegakaraṃ matsarapāruṣyādyakartāram | sthiraṃ lobhādyanākṛṣṭam | paratra bhīruṃ sadā paralokasaśaṃkam | dharmiṣṭhaṃ svavarṇāśramavihitakriyāniṣṭham | udyuktaṃ niralasam | krodhavarjitaṃ tattvavicāraviruddhakrodhahīnam |
kṣamabrāhmaṇābhāve kṣatriyaḥ tadabhāve vaiśyo niyojyaḥ | tad āha sa eva |
20 yadi vipro na vidvān syāt kṣatriyaṃ tatra yojayet |
vaiśyaṃ vā dharmaśāstrajñaṃ śūdraṃ yatnena varjayet || [K 67]
manuḥ |
21 yasya rājña stu kurute śūdro dharmavivecanam |
tasya sīdati tadrāṣṭraṃ paṅke gaur iva paśyataḥ || [M 8.21]
vyāsaḥ |
22 dvijān vihāya yaḥ paśyet kāryāṇi vṛṣalaiḥ saha |
tasya prakṣubhyate rāṣṭraṃ balaṃ koṣaś ca naśyati || [Vy 1.5]
etena vicāraṇe vṛṣalasahāyatā nirastā |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
23 rājā kāryāṇi paśyeta prāḍvivāko 'tha vā dvijaḥ |
nyāyāṅgāny agrataḥ kṛtvā sabhyaśāstramate sthitaḥ || [B 1.65]
24 vivāde pṛcchati praśnaṃ pratipraśnaṃ tathaiva ca |
priyapūrvaṃ prāg vadati prāḍvivākas tataḥ smṛtaḥ || [B 1.69]
vyāsaḥ |
25 vicārānugataṃ pṛṣṭvā sasabhyas tu prayatnataḥ |
vicārayati yenāsau prāḍvivākas tataḥ smṛtaḥ|| [Vy 1.7]
idaṃ tv asya niruktamātram | prāḍvivākatvaṃ tu vyavahārakṣamataiva |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
26 śabdābhidhānatattvajau gaṇanākuśalau śucī |
nānālipijñau kartavyau rājñā gaṇakalekhakau || [B 1.81]
27 ākāraṇe rakṣaṇe ca sākṣyarthaprativādinā |
sabhyādhīnaḥ satyavādī kartavyaḥ śuddhapūruṣaḥ || B 1.82]
śabdo vyākaraṇam | abhidhānaṃ koṣaḥ | sabhyādhīnaḥ vicārakādhīnaḥ | puruṣa praiṣyakaḥ |
kātyāyanaḥ |
28 kulaśīlavayovṛttavittavadbhir amatsaraiḥ |
vaṇigbhiḥ syāt katipayaiḥ kulabhūtair adhiṣṭhitam || [K 58]
karaṇm ity anvayaḥ |
29 ye tv araṇyacarās teṣām araṇye karaṇaṃ bhavet |
senāyāṃ sainikānāṃ ca sārtheṣu vaṇijāṃ tathā || [B 1.73]
karaṇaṃ sabhā |
30 kulādibhyo 'dhikāḥ sabhyās tebhyo 'dhyakṣaḥ smṛto 'dhikaḥ |
31 sarveṣām adhiko rājā dharmyaṃ yatnena niścitam |
uttamādhamamadhyānāṃ vivādānāṃ vicāraṇāt || [B 1.95]
32 upary upari buddhīnāṃ carantīśvarabuddhayaḥ || [B 1.96ab]
kulaṃ vādinor vaṃśyāḥ | ādipadāt śreṇiḥ gaṇaś ca | tatra śreṇir vaṇigādisamūhaḥ gaṇo viprasamūhaḥ | sabhyaḥ niyuktaḥ sādhuḥ | adhyakṣaḥ prāḍvivākaḥ | eteṣāṃ rājāntānāṃ nirṇyakaraṇe uttarottarasya balavattvaṃ jñānotkarṣād ity arthaḥ |
abhiyuktavacanaṃ tu sarvathādaraṇīyam | tad āha nāradaḥ |
33 vaṇikśilpiprayogeṣu kṛṣiraṅgopajīviṣu |
aśakyo nirṇayo hy atra tattvajñair eva kārayat || [NQ 1.5]
upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat — yo yatra vijñas tatsāhityena tannirṇītavyam ity arthaḥ | tathā |
34 tapasvināṃ tu kāryāṇi traividyair eva kārayet |
māyāyogavidāṃ caiva na svayaṃ kopakāraṇāt || [B 1.76]
yeṣāṃ kopād bhayaṃ bhavati teṣāṃ vicāras tajjātīyadvāraiva kārayitavyaḥ |
manuḥ |
35 āśrameṣu dvijātīnāṃ kārye vivadatāṃ mithaḥ |
na vibhrūyān nṛpo dharmaṃ cikīrṣan hitam ātmanaḥ || [M 8.390]
āśrameṣu brahmacaryādiṣu kiṃ vihitaṃ kim avihitam iti vimatau bhaṅgiprakopabhītyā vicārapravṛtto 'pi rājā na viśiṣya dharmaṃ kathayed ity arthaḥ |
36 yathārham etān abhyarcya brāhmaṇaiḥ saha pārthivaḥ |
śāntvena praśamayyādau svadharmaṃ pratipādayet || [M 8.391]
śāntvena priyavacanena ādau teṣāṃ kopaṃ śamayitvā brāhmaṇadvāraiva taddharmaṃ teṣu pratipādayed ity arthaḥ |
atha sabhyopadeśaḥ |
tatra bṛhaspatiḥ |
37 ajñānatimiropetān saṃdehapaṭalānvitān | [B 1.96cd]
38 nirāmayān yaḥ kurute śāstrāñjanaśalākayā |
iha kīrtiṃ rājapūjāṃ labhate svargatiṃ ca saḥ |
tasmāt saṃśayamūḍhānāṃ prakartavyaś ca nirṇayaḥ || [B 1.97]
atra nāradaḥ |
39 nāniyuktena vaktavyaṃ vyavahāre kathaṃcana |
niyuktena tu vaktavyam apakṣapatitaṃ vacaḥ || [NMā 3.1]
śāstrajñena tv aniyuktenāpi vaktavyam | tad āha sa eva |
40 aniyukto niyukto vā śāstrajño vaktum arhati |
daivīṃ vācaṃ sa vadati yaḥ śāstram upajīvati || [NMā 3.2]
daivīṃ śāstrīyām | bṛhaspatiḥ |
41 lobhadveṣādikaṃ tyaktvā yaḥ kuryāt kāryanirṇayam |
śāstroditena vidhinā tasya yajñaphalaṃ bhavet || [B 1.98]
adharmapravṛttau rājñi sabhyakṛtyam āha kātyāyanaḥ |
42 adharmājñāṃ yadā rājā niyuñjīta vivādinām |
vijñāpya nṛpatiṃ sabhyas tadā samyaṅ nivartayet || [K 78]
43 sabhyenāvaśyavaktavyaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ vacaḥ |
śṛṇoti yadi no rājā syāt tu sabhyas tadānṛṇaḥ || [K 77]
44 nyāyamārgād apetaṃ tu jñātvā cittaṃ mahīpateḥ |
vaktavyaṃ tatpriyaṃ nātra sa sabhyaḥ kilbiṣī bhavet || [K 76]
45 adharmataḥ pravṛttaṃ hi nopekṣeran sabhāsadaḥ |
upekṣamāṇāḥ sanṛpā narakaṃ yānty adhomukhāḥ || [K 74]
46 anyāyato yiyāsantaṃ ye 'nuyānti sabhāsadaḥ |
te 'pi tadbhāginas tasmād bodhanīyaḥ sa tair nṛpaḥ || [K 75]
adharmājñā adharmānubandhinī ājñā | sa sabhya iti – yo rājñoktam adharmam anumodatīty arthaḥ | adharmata iti – tathā cotpathagāmino rājña upekṣaṇe sabhyasyāpi doṣa ity arthaḥ | anyāyata it – tathā cotpathagāmino rājño 'nusaraṇe sabhyasyāpi doṣa ity arthaḥ |
manuḥ |
47 pādo 'dharmasya kartāraṃ pādaḥ sākṣiṇam ṛcchati |
pādaḥ sabhāsadaḥ sarvān pādo rājānam ṛcchati || [M 8.18]
adharmasya kartāraṃ vādinam | rājapadam iha vicārakaparam |
kātyāyanaḥ |
48 kāryasya nirṇayaṃ samyak jñātvā sabhyas tathā vadet |
anyathā naiva vaktavyaṃ vaktā dviguṇadaṇḍabhāk || [K 80]
sabhyadoṣāt tu yan naṣṭaṃ deyaṃ sabhyena tat tathā |
kāryaṃ tu kāryiṇām evaṃ niścitaṃ tu vicārayet || [K 81]
evaṃ niścitam asamyagvicāriaṃ punar vicārayed ity arthaḥ |
bṛhaspati |
50 anyāyavādinaḥ sabhyās tathaivotkocajīvinaḥ |
viśvastavañcakāś caiva nirvāsyāḥ sarva eva te || [B 1.107]
viṣṇuḥ |
51, 52 kūṭasākṣiṇāṃ sarvasvāpahāraḥ kāryaḥ |
utkocajīvināṃ sabhyānāṃ ca | [Vi 5.179–180]
bṛhaspatiḥ |
53 kūṭasabhyaḥ kūṭasākṣī brahmahā ca samāḥ smṛtāḥ | [B 5.34ab]
anirṇīte tu yady arthe sambhāṣate raho 'rthinā || [B 1.102ab]
atha vyavahāraṃ vivinakti kātyāyanaḥ |
54 vi nānārthe 'va saṃdehe haraṇaṃ hāra ucyate |
nānāsaṃdehaharaṇād vyavahāra iti smṛtaḥ || [K 26]
sa ca dvividhaḥ | yad āha nāradaḥ:
55 sottaro 'nuttaraś caiva sa vijñeyo dvilakṣaṇaḥ |
sottaro 'bhyadhiko yatra vilekhāt pūrvakaḥ paṇaḥ || [NMā 1.4]
yatra māṣālikhanāt pūrvaṃ yo 'tra jīyate sa ityantaṃ daṇḍaṃ jetre dadātīty evaṃrūpaḥ paṇo vṛttaḥ sa sottaro vyavahāraḥ | tatra sottarapaṇe vivāde parājitaḥ paṇaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca dāpya ity āha sa eva:
56 vivāde sottarapaṇe dvayor yas tatra hīyate |
sa paṇaṃ svakṛtaṃ dāpyo vineyaś ca parājaye || [NMā 1.5]
sa cāyaṃ vyavahāro yatra yadā draṣṭavyas tad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
57 samāsthāne tu pūrvāhṇe kāryāṇāṃ nirṇayaṃ nṛpaḥ |
kuryāc chāstrapraṇītena mārgeṇāmitrakarṣaṇaḥ || [K 60]
sa cāyaṃ vyavahāraś catuṣpād ity āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
58 pūrvapakṣa ādyapādo dvitīyaś cottaro mataḥ |
kriyāpādas tathā cānyaś caturtho nirṇayaḥ smṛtaḥ || [B 1.17]
tathā –
59 mithyoktau sa catuṣpādaḥ pratyavaskandane tathā |
prāṅnyāye ca sa vijñeyo dvipāt saṃpratipattiṣu || [B 2.3]
samyag māṣottare satīti viśeṣaṇīyam | ata eva yatra māṣottarānarhā tatrārthivādo nirṇayaś ceti pādadvayam eva | yatra cottaram ābhāsarūpaṃ tatra bhāṣāpratyarthivacananirṇayā iti pādatrayam eva | na ca – saṃpratipattāv api bhāṣottaranirṇayā iti pādatrayam iti vācyam | uttaravādinaiva bhāṣārthasyāṅgīkṛtatvena nirṇetavyābhāvāt | svoktyaiva tasya parājitatvāt | atra nirṇayakaraṇarūpāyās tṛtīyapravṛtter abhāvāt |
nāradaḥ |
60 guruśiṣyau pitāputrau sampatī svāmibhṛtyakau |
eteṣāṃ samavetānāṃ vyavahāro na sidhyati || [NQ 1.6]
61 ekasya bahubhiḥ sārthaṃ (-dhaṃ?) strībhiḥ preṣyakarais tathā |
anādeyo bhaved vādo vidvadbhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ || [NQ 1.7]
62 rājñā vivarjito yas tu yas tu pauravirodhakṛt |
rāṣṭrasya vā samastasya prakṛtīnāṃ tathaiva ca || [B 2.43 = H 1.38]
63 anye 'pi ye puragrāmamahājanavirodhinaḥ |
anādeyās tu te sarve vyavahārāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
64 smṛtyācāravyapetena mārgeṇa dharṣitaḥ paraiḥ |
āvedayati yad rājñe vyavahārapadaṃ hi tat || [Y 2.5]
tatra pūrvapakṣo bhāṣāpādaḥ | sa cārthivācyaḥ | arthitvaṃ cādhikapīḍāvaśāt | sā ca dravyāpacārād vā prāripsitakāryabhaṅgaprasaṅgād vā na tu prathamanivedanamātreṇa | tad āha vyāsaḥ |
65 yasya cābhyadhikā pīḍā karyaṃ vāpy adhikaṃ bhavet |
tasyārthibhāvo dātavyo na yaḥ pūrvaṃ nivedayet || [Vy ?]
nāradaḥ |
66 vaktavye 'rthe na diṣṭhantam utkrāmantaṃ ca tadvacaḥ |
āsedhayed vivādārthaṃ yāvad āhvānadarśanam || [NMā 1.47]
67 āsedhakāla āsiddha āsedhaṃ yo 'tivartate |
sa vineyo 'nyathā kurvan nāseddhā daṇḍam arhati || NMā 1.51]
āseddhā vivādavimukhapratyarthidhartā arthī | tathā |
68 nadīsaṃtārakāntāradurdeśopaplavādiṣu |
āsiddhaḥ param āsedham utkrāman nāparādhnuyāt || [NMā 1.49]
pratyarthināṃ rājanetavyatve 'pi kāṃścit pratibandhakakāryaprāptiparyantaṃ nānetavyān āha sa eva |
69 nirveṣṭukāmo rogārto yijakṣur vyasane sthitaḥ |
abhiyuktas tathānyena rājakāryodyatas tathā || [NMā 1.52]
70 gavāṃ pracāre gopālāḥ sasyabandhe kṛṣīvalāḥ |
śilpinaś cāpi tatkāle āyudhīyāś ca vigrahe || [NMā 1.53]
71 aprāptavyavahārāś ca dūto dānonmukho vratī |
viṣamasthāś ca nāsedhyā na caitān āhvayen nṛpaḥ || [NMā 1.54]
nirveṣṭukāmo vivāhapravṛttaḥ | āyudhīyāḥ śastropajīvinaḥ | aprāptavyavahāraḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣāvayaskaḥ | ete uttamarṇādinā nāsedhyā na vidhāraṇīyāḥ nivedite 'pi vādinā nāhvātavyāḥ, tatkāryasamāptiparyantaṃ tatkāryavirodhāt |
kātyāyanaḥ |
72 gṛhītagrahaṇo nyāyo na pravartyo mahībhujā |
tasya vā tat samarpyaṃ syāt sthāpayed vā parasya tat || [K 120]

svayaṃ vivādāśaktau pratinidhim āha nāradaḥ |
73 arthinā saṃniyukto vā pratyarthiprahito 'pi vā |
yo yasyārthe vivadate tayor jayaparājayau || [NMā 2.22]

bṛhaspatiḥ |
74 apragalbhajaḍōnmattavṛddhabālarogiṇāṃ |
pūrvottaraṃ vadet tadvad aniyukto 'tha vā naraḥ || [B 1.142]
eteṣāṃ bhāṣām uttaraṃ ca aniyukto niyukto vā hito brūyād ity arthaḥ | kvacit pratinidhyabhāvam āha kātyāyanaḥ |
75 brahmahatyāsurāpāne steye gurvaṅganāgame |
anyeṣv apy abhiśāpeṣu prativādī na dīyate || [K 93]
76 manuṣyamāraṇe steye paradārābhimarṣaṇe |
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇe caiva kanyāharaṇadūṣaṇe || [K 94]
77 pāruṣye kūṭaharaṇe nṛpadrohe tathaiva ca |
prativādī na dātavyaḥ kartā tu vivadet svayam || [K 95]
nāradaḥ |
78 yo na bhrātā na ca pitā na putro na niyogakṛt |
parārthavādī daṇḍyaḥ syād vyavahāreṣu vibruvan || [NMā 2.23]
nyāyārtham upasthitayoś ca karaṇapraveśe pratibhūr grāhyaḥ | arthino 'pi mandapakṣasya daṇḍabhiyā palāyanasaṃbhavāt | tad āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
79 ubhayoḥ pratibhūr grāhyaḥ samarthaḥ kāryanirṇaye | [Y 2.10cd]
pratibhuvas tv abhāve dvau rakṣaṇīyau | tad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
80 atha cet pratibhūr nāsti vādayogyasya vādinaḥ |
sa rakṣito dinasyānte dadyād dūtāya vetanam || [K 117]
dūto rājapreṣyas taddhartā |
tattvataḥ parājito 'pi vicāradoṣaśaṅkayā punarvicāraṃ yācamānaḥ vivādapadād dviguṇaṃ daṇḍam aṅgīkārya vivādaḥ kāryaḥ | tad āha nāradaḥ |
81 tīritaṃ cānuśiṣṭaṃ ca yo manyeta vidharmataḥ |
dviguṇaṃ daṇḍam āsthāya tat kāryaṃ punar uddharet || [NMā 1.65]
tīritaṃ nirṇīya samāpitam | anuśiṣṭaṃ pareṣu tathā pratipāditam |
asadvicāre vicārāntaram arhaty evety āha sa eva |
82 asākṣikaṃ tu yad dṛṣṭaṃ vimārgeṇa ca tīritam |
asammatamatair dṛṣṭaṃ punar darśanam arhati || [NQ 1.14]
asākṣikam aprāmāṇakam |
kātyāyanaḥ |
83 tatrābhiyuktā prabrūyād abhiyuktas tv anantaram |
tayor ukte sadasyas tu prāḍvivākas tataḥ param || [K 121]
ākṣeptā tu na kālaṃ labhate kiṃ tv ākṣipta eva | tad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
84 yasmāt kāryasamārambhāc (?) cirāt tena viniścitaḥ |
tasmān na labhate kālam abhiyuktas tu kālabhāk || [K 134]
nāradaḥ |
85 pratyarthī labhate kālaṃ tryahaṃ pañcāham eva vā | [NQ 3.12]
asyāpavādam āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
86 abhiyoktāpragalbhatvād vaktuṃ notsahate yadi |
tadā kālaḥ pradātavyaḥ kāryaśaktyanurūpataḥ || [B 2.34]
iti vyavahāramukham |
sa ca vyavahāraś catuṣpāt | tad āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
87 bhāṣāpādottarapādau kriyāpādas tathaiva ca |
pratyākalitapādaś ca vyavahāraś catuṣpādaḥ || [B 2.1]
atha bhāṣāpādaḥ \
tatra bṛhaspatiḥ |
88 pratijñādoṣanirmuktaṃ sādhyaṃ satkāraṇānvitam |
niścitaṃ lokasiddhaṃ ca pakṣaṃ pakṣavido viduḥ || [B 2.14]
89 alpākṣaraḥ prabhūtārtho niḥsaṃdigdho nirākulaḥ |
virodhakāraṇair mukto virodhipratiṣedhakaḥ || [B 2.15]
90 yadā tv evaṃvidhaḥ pakṣaḥ kalpitaḥ pūrvavādinā |
dadyāt tatpakṣasaṃbandhaṃ prativādī tadottaram || [B 3.1]
sādhyaṃ sādhyasya siddhyarhasya pratyāyyadharmaviśiṣṭasya dharmiṇo vacanaṃ pakṣaṃ viduḥ | tena svamatasya vacanaṃ pakṣaṃ vidur ity arthaḥ | pratijñādoṣauḥ pratijñāvirodhādibhir ujjhitam | satkāraṇānvitam asphuraddoṣaliṅgasampannam | evaṃ ca tvaṃ mahyaṃ śatasya dhārayaḥ matta ṛṇatvena gṛhītatāvaddhanakatvād iti bhāṣāśarīram uktaṃ bhavati | atra ca dehīty arthitāvyañjakamātraṃ na tu bhāṣāntartatam ity avadheyam | niścitaṃ apracalārthakam | tena dhārayati na vetyādikam apāstam | lokasiddhaṃ lokavyavahārāviruddhārthakam | evaṃ ca –
91 tṛṇakāṣṭheṣṭakākiṇvasūtracarmāsthivarmaṇām |
hetipuṣpaphalānāṃ ca vṛddhis tu na nivartate || [B 10.23]
iti bṛhaspativacanam ālamby lokaviruddhānantavṛddhiprārthanam api bhāṣety apāstam | ata eva bṛhaspatiḥ |
92 kevalaṃ śāstram āśritya na kartavyo vinirṇayaḥ |
yuktihīnavicāre tu dharmahāniḥ prajāyate || [B 1.114]
yuktir vyavahāraḥ | bhavadevas tu – yatra śrutamātra eva lokānāṃ sampratyayas tal lokasiddham | tena nirdhanakṛto lakṣasaṃkhyasvadhanaprayogākṣepo bādhita ity āha | alpākṣaraḥ yāvadbhir akṣarair vinā viśiṣṭahetuprayuktasādhyopahitapakṣapratipādanaṃ na bhavati tāvanmātrākṣarakaḥ | prabhūtārthaḥ niruktārthaka eva | nirākulaḥ paurvāparyaviparyāsādiśūnyas tena subodho bhavati | virodhikāraṇaiḥ svasādhyaviparītavyāptair hetubhiḥ śūnyaḥ | yathā madvibhakto 'py ayam arjakatvād idānīm arjitaṃ mayi dadātv ityādikaṃ tadvyatiriktaḥ satpakṣaḥ | atra madvibhaktatvasya pakṣaviśeṣaṇatve pratijñāvirodhasambhave pratijñādoṣanirmuktam ity atra evaitallābhe idaṃ prapañcanamātram iti draṣṭavyam | virodhipratiṣedhaka iti – yāvatprakāram uttaraṃ sambhāvyaṃ tāvatpratiṣedhako yathā bhavati tathā pakṣanirdeśaḥ kārya ity arthaḥ \
nāradaḥ |
93 sāras tu vyavahārāṇāṃ pratijñā samudāhṛtā |
tad dhānau hīyate vādī taraṃs tām uttaro bhavet ||
pratijñā tāvat tvaṃ mahyaṃ śatasya dhāraya ity evaṃrūpā | tasyā hānau aparipūraṇe hīyate bhajyate tāṃ taran paripūrayan uttaraḥ śreṣṭho bhavatīty arthaḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ |
94 yaṃ cārtham abhiyuñjīta na taṃ viprakṛtiṃ nayet |
na ca pakṣāntaraṃ gacchet gacchan pūrvāt sa hīyate || [B 2.7]
viprakṛtiṃ nyūnatām adhikatāṃ vā | yathā śataṃ dhārayasīti bhāṣitvā paścāt pañcāśatam eva vā sārdhaśatameva veti punar bhāṣaṇam | pakṣāntaram iti – śataṃ suvarṇān dhārayasīti ādau bhāṣitvā viramya paścāt gāś ca dhārayasīti pakṣāntaram ity arthaḥ | idaṃ cottarāvarodhāt pūrvam aviruddham eva tadantaraṃ tu viruddham,
95 uttareṇāvaruddhasya nivṛttaṃ lekhanaṃ bhavet | [NQ 2.22cd]
ityādivacanāt | tathā –
96 upasthite tatas tasmin vādī pakṣaṃ prakalpayet |
niravadyaṃ satpratijñaṃ pramāṇāgamasaṃyutam || [B 2.5]
97 deśaṃ kālaṃ samāṃ māsaṃ pakṣāhojātināma ca |
dravyasaṃkhyodayaṃ pīḍāṃ kṣamāliṅgaṃ ca lekhayet || [B 2.6]
āgamaḥ ṛṇādipramāṇaṃ sākṣipatrādikam | yady api tṛtīyapāde pattrādikīrtanaṃ tathāpi pakṣasya saṃbhāvanārtham idānīm api tatsāmānyākāreṇa nirdeśyam | udayo vṛddhiḥ | pīḍāṃ yady aham ṛṇikas tadā pratyāsattāṃ kuto na mām ayam apīḍayad iti tadarthaṃ pīḍito 'yaṃ mayeti vācyam | apīḍane vā kṣamāhetur vācyaḥ | kātyāyanaḥ |
98 niveśya kālaṃ varṣaṃ ca māsaṃ pakṣaṃ tithiṃ tathā |
velāṃ pradeśaṃ viṣayaṃ sthānaṃ jātyākṛtī vayaḥ || K 124]
99 sādhyaṃ pramāṇaṃ dravyaṃ ca saṃkhyāṃ nāma tathātmanaḥ |
rājñāṃ ca kramaśo nām nivāsaṃ sādhyanāma ca || K 125]
100 kramāt pitṝṇāṃ nāmāni pīḍām āhartṛdāpakau |
kṣamāliṅgāni cānyāni pakṣaṃ saṃkīrtya kalpayet || [K 126]
etac ca sarvaṃ virodhyantaranirākaraṇāya vācyam | anyathā tu pratijñāhetū eva vācyau |
nāradaḥ |
101 bhāṣāyām uttaraṃ yāvat pratyarthī nābhilekhayet |
arthī tu lekhayet tāvad yāvan nottaradarśanam | [NMā 2.7]
102 avaṣṭabdhasyottareṇa nivṛttaṃ lekhanaṃ bhavet || [NMā 2.22cd]
bṛhaspatiḥ |
103 ūnādhikaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ tāvad vādī viśodhayet |
na dadyād uttaraṃ yāvat pratyarthī sabhyasaṃnidhau || [B 2.22]
atha pakṣābhāsāḥ |
tān āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
104 aprasiddhaṃ sadoṣaṃ ca nirarthaṃ niḥprayojanam |
asādhyaṃ vā viruddhaṃ vā rājā pakṣaṃ vivarjayet || [B 2.8]
105 na kenacit kṛto yas tu so 'prasiddha udāhṛtaḥ |
anyārthaḥ svārthahīnaś ca sadoṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || [B 2.9]
106 alpāparādhaś cālpārtho nirarthak iti smṛtaḥ |
kāryabādhāvihīnaś ca vijñeyo niḥprayojanaḥ || [B 2.10]
107 kusīdādyaiḥ parair hīno vyavahāro nirarthakaḥ |
vākpāruṣyādibhiś caiva vijñeyo niḥprayojanaḥ || [B 2.11]
108 mamānena pradātavyaṃ śaśaśṛṅgamayaṃ dhanuḥ |
asaṃbhāvyam asādhyaṃ tu pakṣam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || [B 2.12]
109 yasmin nāvedite pakṣe prāḍvivāke 'tha rājani |
pure rāṣṭre virodhaḥ syād viruddhaḥ so 'bhidhīyate || [B 2.13]
kusīdādyaiś caturdaśabhiḥ | vākpāruṣyādibhir ity atra hīna ity anuṣajyate | tathā –
110 purarāṣṭraviruddhaś ca yaś ca rājavivarjitaḥ |
anekapadasaṃkīrṇaḥ pūrvapakṣo na sidhyati || [K 136]
111 bahupratijñaṃ yat kāryaṃ vyavahāreṣu niścitam |
kāmaṃ tad api gṛhṇīyād rājā tattvabubhutsayā || [K 137]
anekapadeti – anekakriyākavyavahāraviṣayam etat | tad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
112 na caikasmin vivāde tu kriyā syād vādinor dvayoḥ|
na cārthasiddhir ubhayor na caikatra kriyādvayam || [K 190]
idam api na heyaṃ hiṃ tu rājñā lekhyam eva nirūpaṇam asya kramaśaḥ | yatra tu ekahetukaiva nānāsādhyasiddhis tatra kramo 'pi na | kātyāyanaḥ |
113 deśakālavihīnaś ca dravyasaṃkhyāvivarjitaḥ |
sādhyapramāṇahīnaś ca pakṣo 'nādeya iṣyate || [K 138]
deśeti – yatra deśādibhir eva nirṇayas tatraiva tadupayogo na tu sarvatra | anyathā adṛṣṭārthatāpatter iti draṣṭavyam | vyāsaḥ |
114 pāṇḍulekhena phalake bhūmau vā prathamaṃ likhet |
nyūnādhikaṃ ca saṃśodhya paścāt pattre niveśeyet || [Vy 1.23]
phalakaṃ kāṣṭhādipaṭṭaṃ | tathā ca ādau bhāṣāṃ bhūmau niveśya nyūnādhikaṃ saṃśodhya pattre likhet | kātyāyanaḥ |
115 anyad uktaṃ likhed anhyad yo 'rthiprathyarthināṃ vacaḥ |
cauravac chāsayet taṃ tu dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || [K132]
anyad it – anyathoktaṃ anyathā kṛtvā likhati cauravad daṇḍa ity arthaḥ \
iti vyavahāracintāmaṇau
bhāṣāpādaḥ \
athottarapādaḥ |
tatra nirdoṣāyāṃ bhāṣāyāṃ satyāṃ jñātatadarthena uttaraṃ deyam | tad āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
116 viniścite pūrvapakṣe grāhyāgrāhyaviśodhite |
pratijñārthe sthirībhūte lekhayed uttaraṃ tataḥ || [B 3.2]
viniścite svarūpato 'vadhārite | yājñavalkyaḥ |
117 śrutārthasyottaraṃ lekhyaṃ pūrvāvedakasaṃnidhau |
tato 'rthī lekhayet sadyaḥ pratijñātārthasādhakam || [Y 2.7]
118 tatsiddhau siddhim āpnoti viparītam ato 'nyathā | [Y 2.8ab]
yo 'rthaḥ pariśodhitatvādiḥ tasya sādhanaṃ sākṣyādi | tasya siddhau upanyastasya pramāṇasya siddho nirvāhaṇe | siddhiṃ vijayam | anyathā 'nirvāhaṇe | viparītaṃ avijayam | bhaṅgam iti tu mitākṣarā | śrutārthasya bhāṣāvacanasya | pūrvāvedako bhāṣitā | arthī prativādī | pratijñātaḥ pratyarthipratijñātaḥ | sadyaḥ uttaralikhanānantaram | kātyāyanaḥ |
119 śrutvā lekhayato hy arthaṃ pratyarthī kāraṇād yadi |
kālaṃ vivāde yāceta tasya deyo na saṃśayaḥ || [K 145]
120 sadyo vaikāhapañcāhau tryahaṃ vā gurulāghavāt |
labhetāsau tripakṣaṃ vā saptāhaṃ vā ṛṇādiṣu || [K 146]
atra vyavasthām āha sa eva |
121 sadyaḥ kṛte sadyo vādaḥ samātīte dinaṃ kṣipet |
ṣaḍābdike trirātraṃ tu saptāhaṃ dvādaśābdike || [K 154]
122 viṃśatyabde daśāhaṃ tu samārthaṃ vā labheta saḥ |
māsaṃ triṃśatsamātīte tripakṣaṃ parato labhet || [K 155]
123 kālaṃ śaktiṃ viditvā tu kāryāṇāṃ ca balābalam |
alpaṃ vā bahukālaṃ vā dadyāt pratyarthine prabhuḥ || [K 147]
prabhur iha vicārakaḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ |
124 ekāhatryahapañcāhasaptāhaṃ pakṣam eva vā |
māsam ṛtutrayaṃ vāpi labhate śaktyapekṣayā || [B 3.4]
sadyoviṣayaṃ kiyantam apy āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
125 sāhasasteyapāruṣyago'bhiśāpātyaye striyām |
vivādayet sadya eva kālo 'nyatrecchayā smṛtaḥ || [Y 2.12]
gaur atra dogdhrī | gotvam upalakṣaṇam – yatra kālātyayena bhogādikṣatis tatparam | atyaye maraṇe saṃbhāvyamāne | striyāṃ kulastriyāṃ cāritryavivāde dāsyāṃ vā svatvavivāde | idaṃ ca saptagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam – yatra kālātipāte pratikūlaṃ tatparam | tad āha kātyāynaḥ |
126 vyapeti gauravaṃ yatra vināśas tyāga eva vā |
kālaṃ tatra na kuryāt tu kāryam ātyayikaṃ hi tat || [K 149]
anyatra ṛṇādau | tad āha nāradaḥ |
127 gahanatvād vivādānām asāmarthyāt smṛter api |
ṛṇādiṣu haret kālaṃ kāmaṃ tattvabubhutsayā || [NMā 1.44]
yājñavalkīyam apīcchāpadaṃ tattvabubhutsāparam eva | haret hārayet | vicāraka iti śeṣaḥ | vyāsaḥ |
128 rājadaivakṛto doṣas tasmin kāle yadā bhavet |
avadhityāgamātreṇa na bhavet sa parājitaḥ || [Vy ?]
129 rājadaivakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ sākṣibhiḥ pratipādayet |
jaihmyena vartamānas tu daṇḍyo dāpyaś ca tad dhanam || [Vy ?]
avadhyatikrameto rājadevakasya pramitau na tadatikrāmako 'parādhyati | jaihmyāt tu tadatikraman daṇḍyaś ca bhaṅgī ca bhavatīty arthaḥ | kātyāyanaḥ |
130 abhiyukto 'bhoyoktāraṃ nābhiyuñjīta karhicit |
anyatra daṇḍapāruṣyasteyasaṃgrahaṇātyayāt || [K 163]
daṇḍādiṣu pañcasv api mamāpy anena daṇḍapāruṣyādikaṃ kṛtam ity abhiyogo dātavya eva, tathaivābhiyoganistārāt | yājñavalkyaḥ |
131 abhiyogam anistīrya nainaṃ pratyabhiyojayet |
abhiyuktaṃ na cānyena noktaṃ viprakṛtiṃ nayet || [Y 2.9]
132 kuryāt pratyabhiyogaṃ ca kalahe sāhaseṣu ca | [Y 2.10ab]
anyenābhiyuktaṃ nābhiyuñjīta | viprakṛtim iti āvedanakāle 'nyathā lekhayitvā bhāṣākāle nānyathā lekhayed ity arthidṣūpadeśadvayam | nāradaḥ |
133 pakṣasya vyāpakaṃ sāram asaṃdigdham anākulam |
avyākhyāgamyam ity etad uttaraṃ tadvido viduḥ || [NQ 3.2]
pakṣasya bhāṣitahetor vyāpakam ācchādakam | tad uktam –
134 pūrvapakṣārthasaṃbandhaṃ pratipakṣaṃ niveśayet || iti | [NMā 2.2cd = K 159cd]
sāraṃ prakṛtābhiyogi | asaṃdigdham ucyamānaṃ sat niścīyamānam | anākulaṃ pūrvāparavirodharahitam | avyākhyāgamyam adhyāhārādikaṃ vinaiva pratītam | yady api saṃpratipattir ajñānādikaṃ ca uttaraṃ na bhāṣitahetvācchādakaṃ tathāpi tadabhisaṃdhinā prayuktam eveti draṣṭavyam | ata eva uttiryate nistīryate prakṛtābhiyogo 'nenety uttaram iti prāñcaḥ | nyāyas tu – pakṣasya svapratijñātasyādhāryamāṇatvāder vyāpakaṃ sādhakam ity āhuḥ | pakṣasya dhāryamāṇatve sādhye pakṣīkṛtasya śatasya vyāpakam abhivyāpakam | tathā cārdham atrāgṛhītam ardhaṃ ca pariśodhitam ity api mithyākāraṇaghaṭitam uttaraṃ pakṣābhivyāpakatvāt saṃgṛhyata evety anye | atra caitādṛśārthakṃ vacanam uttaram |
tad evārthacāturvidhyena vibhajate kātyāyanaḥ |
135 satyaṃ mithyottaraṃ caiva pratiyavaskandanaṃ tathā |
pūrvanyāyavidhiś caiva uttaraṃ syāc caturvidham || [K 165]
vyāsaḥ |
136 sādhyasya satyavacanaṃ pratipattir udāhṛtā |
kāraṇaṃ syād avaskando mithyā syāt sādhyanihnutiḥ || [Vy 1.24]
sādyasya bhāṣitasya sahetusādhyasy kaṇṭhato 'rthato vā nihnavo mithottaram | kevalasādhyanihnavas tu saṃpatipattibhinneṣu triṣv apy uttareṣu samāna iti draṣṭavyam | bṛhaspatiḥ |
137 mithyāyāṃ ca catuṣpādaḥ pratyavaskandane tathā |
prāṅnyāye ca sa vijñeyo dvipāt saṃpatipattiṣu || [B 2.3]
atha saṃpratipattiḥ |
138 anuktvā kāraṇaṃ yatra pakṣaṃ vādī prapadyate |
pratipattis tu sā jñeyā kāraṇe dūṣaṇaṃ pṛthak || [B 3.14]
kāraṇaṃ parahetudūṣaṇakāraṇam | vādī pratyarthī | kāraṇe kāraṇottare pṛthak dūṣaṇaṃ bhaved ity arthaḥ | saṃpratipattiś ca siddhasādhanam āpādayantī saduttaram | na caivaṃ bhāṣitur nigrahaḥ, vicārasyāsya tattvanirṇayārthakatvāt | tatra ca siddhasādhanasyādoṣatvād iti | atra ca na kriyāpādo nāpi jayaparājayāvadhāraṇalakṣaṇapratyākalitapāda iti dvipād eva vyavahāras tat sūktam – dvipāt saṃpratipattiṣv iti |
atha mithyottaram |
tatra kātyāyanaḥ |
139 abhiyukto 'bhiyogasya yadi kuryād apahnavam |
mithyā tat tu vijānīyād uttaraṃ vyavahārataḥ || [K 167]
abhiyogo hetur gṛhītatvādiḥ | tena hetvapalāpa eva mithyottaram iti sāram | vyāsaḥ |
140 mithyaitan nābhijānāmi mama tatra na saṃnidhiḥ |
ajātaś cāsmi tatkāla iti mithyā caturvidhā || [Vy 1.28]
atra mithyaitad iti kaṇṭhato, na jānāmītyādikaṃ trikam arthato 'pahnavaḥ | tad āha kātyāyano 'pi |
141 śrutvā bhāṣārtham anyas tu yadi taṃ pratiṣedhati |
arthataḥ śabdato vāpi mithyā taj jñeyam uttaram || [K 166]
bhāṣārthaṃ sahetusādhyam | atra sādhyāpahnavoktir uttarāntarvyavacchedadvārā mithyottaralakṣaṇopayuktā | hetvapahnava eva tu svarūpāddhir nāma sthāpanādoṣa iti vivektavyam |
tatra gṛhītatvāt tvaṃ dhārayasīti bhāṣāyāṃ mayā na gṛhītam iti śabdataḥ | kālaviśeṣagarbhāyāṃ tasyāṃ tadā nāhaṃ jāta ity arthataḥ | deśakālaviśeṣagarbhāyāṃ tasyāṃ tadā tatra nāham āsam ity arthataḥ | deśādimatyāṃ tacchūnyāyāṃ vā tasyāṃ na jānāmīty arthata eva, yogyāsmaraṇenārthatas tadgrahaṇapratipādanāt | atra ca caramatrayaṃ grahaṇāskandamukhena grahaṇābhāvapratipādakaṃ sāpadeśamithyottaram ity ucyate | ādyaṃ mithyottaramātram | na jānāmīti tu sāpadeśamithyottaram abhimāmātrāt | śeṣaṃ tu dvayaṃ vyāptatayā samyak |
na caivaṃ samīcor grahaṇāskandayor asaṃnidhānājanmanor eva pratipādyatā syād iti vācyam | tasyābhāvarūpatayā grahaṇāpekṣayā pratipādanagauravāt | tābhyāṃ cāgraṇasya vyāpakānupalabdhyā pratyāyane 'pi gauravāt | tatpratyāyanāśaktāv api saṃśayatādavasthayāc ca | na hi tadā jātas tatra san gṛhṇāty eveti niyamaḥ | dharmavyavahāre ca cchalam avaśyanirasyam | tasmāc caturṣv api mithyottareṣu sthāpakenaiva dṛṣṭana grahaṇaṃ (?) pramāpaṇīyam iti |
yat tu pitrādigṛhītatvabhāṣāyāṃ tadgrahādhikaraṇatvenābhimatakālāpekṣayā caramajātasya tatputrasya na jānāmītyādikam uttaraṃ taduttarapratirūpakam, arthato 'pi sthāpitahetvapahnavāsambhavāt |
na caivam uttarābhāvād eva tatra sthāpakasy jaya iti vācyam | dharmavyavahāre cchalasyāvaśyanirasyatvena tatra sthāpakena grahaṇasyāvaśyapramāpaṇiyatvāt | ata eva prakāśakraye nāṣṭikenādattatvādikam api pramāpaṇīyam iti smaranti | anyathā dattatvāder dūṣakenānuktatvād adattatvādipratipādanaṃ tatrādhikaṃ syāt | tena ca dattatvādyabhidhāne tenaiva ca tatpratipādyam ity api syāt nāṣṭikoktatatsvatvādyāskandakatvād dattatvāder iti |
kāraṇottaraṃ cāparam |
kāraṇaṃ sthāpakasādhyasya dhāryamāṇatvasya dhvaṃsakāraṇaṃ niryātanādi tadrūpam | ata eva mithyottarād asya bhedaḥ | tad dhi dharyamāṇatvasyābhāvaprayojakam agrahaṇaṃ na tu dhvaṃsakaṃ kadāpy adhāritatvāt | ata eva prāṅnyāyād asya bhedaḥ | prāṅnyāyo hi dhāryamāṇatvasāmānyābhāvajñāpaka iti |
etac ca trividham – pūrvādyuktahetvapekṣayādhikabalaṃ samabalaṃ durbalaṃ ca |
tatrādyaṃ pratyavaskandanam | tad āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
142 arthinābhihito yo 'rthaḥ pratyarthī yadi taṃ tathā |
prapadya kāraṇaṃ brūyāt pratyavaskandanaṃ hi tat || [B 3.19]
arthinoktaṃ gṛhītatvahetuṃ satyam ity abhyupagamya yadīdānīm adhāryamāṇatve pariśodhitatvādikaṃ kāraṇaṃ brūyāt tad uttaraṃ pratyavaskandanaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ | yathā mayā tvattaḥ śataṃ gṛhītam iti satyaṃ kiṃ tu pariśoditham iti | idaṃ ca – tvaṃ mahyam idānīṃ śatasya dhārayaḥ mattaḥ pratideyatayā gṛhītatāvaddhanatvād iti bhāṣāyāṃ niryātanasthale vyabhicāravāraṇāyāpariśodhitatve satīti hetau viśeṣaṇaṃ sthāpakasya hṛdisthaṃ tasya cāsiddhir uttaravākyārthaḥ | tathā ca hetuviśeṣaṇāsiddhiparam idaṃ kāraṇottaram | kātyāyano 'pi |
143 arthinābhihito yo 'rthaḥ pratiarthī yadi taṃ tathā |
prapadya kāraṇaṃ brūyād ādharyaṃ bhṛgur abravīt || [K 170]
ādharyaṃ durbalatvam | pūrvapakṣasyeti śeṣaḥ | nāradaḥ |
144 ādharyaṃ pūrvapakṣasya yasminn arthavaśād bhavet |
vivāde sākṣiṇas tatra praṣṭavyāḥ prativādinaḥ || [N 1.164]
pradīpakṛtas tu – kāraṇaṃ dhāryamāṇatve kāraṇaṃ gṛhītatvaṃ tat prapadyābhyupetya brūyāt pariśodhanādikam iti śeṣaḥ ity evaṃ krameṇa yojanām arthād āhuḥ | pariśodhitatvaṃ ca sthāpanāhetuviśeṣaṇaṃ kaṣṭharaveṇoktam iti cāhuḥ |
kecit tu – prapadya sthāpanāhetuṃ pratītya yd viparītavacanaṃ tat kāraṇottaram iti tritayaparam evedaṃ vākyam ity āhuḥ | tan na – samahīnabalakāraṇottarayoḥ sthāpanāyā ādharyasambhave na etad vākyasya tadubhayaviṣyakatvād iti | vastutas tu – tad dhanaṃ matsādhāraṇaṃ madavibhaktatvadarjitatvād ity atra naitad evaṃ tvadvibhaktamadarjitatvād ity atra balavatkāraṇottare kaṇṭhoktasyāvibhaktatvasya khaṇḍanāt abhiyogadhvaṃsasya cājananān na prācīnā vyākhyā kiṃ tu prapadyābhyupetya bhāṣitahetuṃ viśeṣyabhāgamātraṃ kāraṇam anabhiyojyatāprayojakarūpaṃ vibhaktatvaniryātitatvādi yad brūte tad balavatkāraṇottaram iti vyākhyā jyāyasīti |
samabalaṃ tu – madīyeyaṃ bhūḥ kramāgatatvād iti bhāṣāyām idam evottaram | idaṃ ca satpratipakṣatvaparam |
durbalottaraṃ tu – viṃśativarṣād ārabhya mameyam ādhiviṣayā bhūḥ tāvatsamayād ārabhya svāminā mayy āhitatvād iti | idam api satpratipakṣatvaparam |
145 ādhau pratigrahe krīte pūrvaiva balavattareti | [Y2.23cd]
atra ca balavati prativādinaḥ antyayos tu sthāpakasya pramāṇam anusaṃdheyam |
tad ayuktam,
146 gurāv abhihite hetau prativādikriyā bhavet |
durbale vādinaḥ proktā tulye pūrvakryaiv ceti || [?]
kātyāyanaḥ |
147 kāraṇāt pūrvapakṣo 'pi uttaratvaṃ prapadyate |
ataḥ kriyā sadā proktā pūrvapakṣaprasādhinī || [K 211]
kāraṇāt balavattvāt | uttaratvaṃ uttamatvam |
prāṅnyāyottaraṃ tu – asminn arthe mayāyaṃ pūrvaṃ jita iti rūpam | yad āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
ācāreṇāvasanno 'pi punar lekayate yadi |
so 'bhidheyo jitaḥ pūrvaṃ prāṅnyāyas tu sa ucyate || [B 3.21]
ācāreṇa vyavahāreṇa | avasanno bhaṅgī | lekhayate bhāṣām |
atra cottaravādina eva kriyā tenaiva pūrvajayasya vibhāvanīyatvāt | tathā ca hārītaḥ
prāṅnyāyakāraṇoktau tu pratyarthī nirdiśet kriyām |
mithyoktau pūrvavādī tu pratipattau na sā bhavet || [B 1.29]
kāranoktau balavatkāraṇoktau | atra ca prāṅnyāye balavatpūrvapramāṇabādhaḥ sthāpanāhetudoṣaḥ | nirṇītatvena saṃśayābhāvād asiddhir ity anye |
athottarābhāsāḥ |
tatra kātyāyanaḥ |
150 pakṣaikadeśe yat satyam ekadeśe ca kāraṇam |
mithyā caivaikadeśe syāt saṃkarāt tad anuttaram || [K 189]
atra kecit – yathā śatagrahaṇe bhāṣite pañcāśataṃ dhārayāmy eva pañcaviṃśatiḥ pariśodhitāḥ pañcaviṃśatir na gṛhītā ityādy udāharaṇam | atra ca kātyāyanavacanaṃ bījaṃ | tathā hi –
151 na caikasmin vivāde tu kriyā syād vadinor dvayoḥ |
na cārthasiddhir ubhayor na caikasmin kriyādvayam || iti [K 190]
ekatra dvayor vādinor na kriyā dvayī ca na kriyā dvayoś ca na jaya iti vākyārthaḥ | yathoktasaṃkīrṇottarasya ca grāhyatve tat sarvaṃ prasajyetety āhuḥ | tan mandam – na hīdṛśo viṣaya eva na saṃbhavati bahuśo darśanāt | na cedṛśam uttaraṃ na deyaṃ yathāvasthitārthottaradānasya niṣeddhum aśakyatvāt | na ca sakala evākṣepe mithyottaram eva kāryaṃ śatasyāgṛhītatvād iti vācyam | na hi vijñā eva vivadante kiṃtv ājñā api | na ca ta ita eva paryanuyojyāḥ kiṃ tu tattvato nirūpyāḥ –
152 chalaṃ nirasya bhūtena vyavahārān nayen nṛpaḥ [Y 2.1ab]
ityādivacanāt |
kiṃ ca – na saduttarāntaram atra saṃbhavatīty ata evāsya heyatā | upāyasyopāyāntarādūṣakatvāt | na ca vacanād evāsya heyatā, etad vacanasyādṛṣṭarthatāpatteḥ |
api ca – śataṃ na gṛhītam ity asya nāgrahaṇamātram arthaḥ śatapadānarthakyāpatteḥ | nāpi śatāgrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaniṣedhe śeṣābhyanujñāpatteḥ | nāpi śatapadaṃ pakṣaprāptānuvāda evam ekadeśasya gṛhītasya gṛhītatvavibhāvanād eva sthāpako nirapavādam eva tāvad dhanaṃ labhetety aniṣṭaphalakam uttaraṃ syāt | tasmād ekadeśe ekasminn eva deśe yad uttaraṃ saṃkīrthate tad anuttaraṃ śeṣaṃ ekadeśapadadvayaṃ cānuvādaḥ | tathā hi mayā śataṃ na gṛhītaṃ gṛhītaṃ vā pariśodhitaṃ dhārayāmy evetyādi |
yat tu bhinnabhinnāvacchedena kāraṇādisparśi tat saduttaram eva avacchedabhedena sāṅkaryasyaivābhāvāt | atraiva hārītenāpi mīmāṃsitam –
153 mithyottaraṃ kāraṇaṃ ca syātām ekatra ced ubhe |
satyaṃ cāpi sahānena tatra grāhyaṃ kim uttaram || [H 1.23]
154 yat prabhūtārthaviṣayaṃ yatra vā syāt kriyāphalam |
uttaraṃ tat tu vijñeyam asaṃkīrṇam ato ‘nyathā || [H 1.24abcd]
yad iti – pracurārthaviṣayakam uttarāṃśam ādāya vicāra upakramaṇīyaḥ | tulyārthaviṣayatve tu yatra kriyāyā bhuktyādeḥ phalaṃ nirṇayaḥ śīghraṃ bhavati tadaṃśasyaiva pramāṇaṃ grāhyam | tad uktam – yatra vā syāt kriyāphalam iti | idaṃ cottaram asaṃkīrṇam iva | yat tv ato ‘nyathā tat saṃkīrṇaṃ heyam iti | tad ayaṃ vartulārthaḥ – śatābhiyoge pañcāśat pariśodhitāḥ pañcaviṃatir dhāryante pañcaviṃśatis tu naiva gṛhītā ity uttare kāraṇabhāga ādau vicāryaḥ | paścāt tu apahnutāḥ pañcaviṃśatir api arthipramāṇena vā sādhyāḥ pratyarthipramāṇena vā badhyāḥ |
na caivaṃ saty etadvacanavirodha eva | nyāyavacanānām utsargato nyāyamūlakatvenaiva tadvacanasyāpi laghvarthapramāṇaparigrahābhādhakatvāt | sati nirṇayapramāṇe ca tadaṃśe ‘pi prakaraṇārambhakasaṃśayasyāvaśyanirasyatvāt | na ca yat prabhūtārthaviṣayam ityādivacanavaśād eva laghvarthapramāṇāgrāhyatā, tathā saty etat smṛtīnāṃ śrutimūlatāpatteḥ | na caitad iṣṭam eva, asaṃbhavanmūlāntaratvasya tatropādhitvāt | yūpahastyādismṛtau tathā siddhāntatvāt | āsāṃ ca nyāyamūlakatvasyaiva saṃbhavāt |
155 mithyākāraṇasaṃbhede grāhyaṃ kāraṇam uttaram | [H 1.24ef]
ityādikam api vacanam evam eva neyam |
tasmāt tāvat prakaraṇārambhakasaṃśayo ‘nuvartate nirṇāyakaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ labhyate tāvad vicāraṇīyam iti paramārthaḥ |
bhavadevapradīpādayo ‘py evam |
kātyāyanaḥ |
156 prakṛtena tv asaṃbaddham atyalpam atibhūri ca |
pakṣaikadeśavyāpy eva tat tunaivottaraṃ bhavet || [K 188]]
157 asaṃbaddhapadavyāpi nigūḍhārthaṃ tathākulam |
vyākhyāgamyam asāraṃ ca nottaraṃ śasyate budhaiḥ || [K 174]
prakṛtena prakṛtabhāṣayā | atyalpaṃ pratijñāmātraṃ na dhārayāmītyādi | atibhūri bahuhetukam | pakṣaikadeśavyāpi bhāṣaikadeśācchādakam | asaṃbaddhapadavyāpi ananvitārthakapadavyāptam | nigūḍhārtham aprasiddhārtham | ākulaṃ parasparaviruddhārthakam | vyākhyāgamyaṃ lakṣaṇādinā vivakṣitārthabodhakam | asāraṃ jātyuttaram |
tathā —
158 prapadya kāraṇaṃ pūrvam anyad gurutaraṃ yadi |
praivākyagataṃ brūyāt sādhyate tad dhi netarat || [K 191]
ādau laghukāraṇam abhidhāya paścād balavattadabhidadhatas tāvad valavad eva grāhyaṃ tattvanirṇayārtham ity arthaḥ |
bṛhaspatiḥ —
159 pūrvapakṣe yathārthaṃ tu na dadyād uttaraṃ tu yaḥ |
pratyarthī dāpanīyaḥ syāt sāmādibhir upakramaiḥ || [B 3.7]
160 priyapūrvaṃ vacaḥ sāma bhedas tu bhadarśanam |
arthāpakarṣaṇaṃ daṇḍas tāḍanaṃ bandhanaṃ tathā || [B 3.8]
161 upāyair deśyamānas tu na dadyād uttaraṃ tu yaḥ |
atikrānte saptarātre jito ‘sau daṇḍam arhati || [B 2.4]
162 unmattamattanirdhūtā mahāpātakadūṣitāḥ |
jaḍātikruddhabālāś ca vijñeyās te niruttarāḥ || [B 1.173]
pūrvapakṣa iti – uttaradānaśaktaḥ san sāmādināpi pṛṣṭo yaḥ saptarātraparyantenāpi nottaraṃ dadāti sa bhaṅgī vyavahartavyaḥ | unmattādayas tu svajñaparadvāreṇottaraṃ dāpayitavyā ity arthaḥ |
tathā —
163 ubhayor likhite kārye prārabdhe tattvanirṇaye |
ayuktaṃ tatra yo brūyāt sa tadarthāt tu hīyate || [B? = K 206cdef]
164 pūrvottare niviṣṭe tu vicāre saṃpraveśite | [B 3.42ab]
nirṇiktaṃ tu tayor tatra vacanaṃ vādinor bhṛguḥ || [B?]
165 mohād vā yadi vā śāṭhyāt yan noktaṃ pūrvavādinā |
uttarāntargataṃ vāpi tad grāhyam ubhayor api || [B 2.17 = K 193]
166 śrutaṃ ca likhitaṃ caiva cintitaṃ tu viśodhitam | [B 2.29cd]
prathame ‘hani tasyaiva vivādavidhir ucyate || [B?]
pūrvottare bhāṣāyām uttare ca saṃvṛtte vicāre prārabdhe vādinor vacanaṃ nirṇiktaṃ śādhitaṃ grāhyam | tad eva prapañcayati – mohād ityādi | śāṭhyaṃ tātkārikavākstambhādi | evaṃ ca vicārapravṛttiparyantaṃ bhāṣottarayoḥ śodhane siddhe
167 pratijñāṃ pūrayed vādī yāvan nottaradarśanam [NQ 2.22ab]
ity atrāpy uttarapadaṃ vicārārambhaparam iti draṣṭavyam |
iti vyavahāracintāmaṇau
uttarapādaḥ |
atha kriyāpādaḥ |
tatrottarābhāse kriyānapekṣa eva bhaṅgaḥ | saduttare tu kriyā deyā | tatra yājñavalkyaḥ —
168 tato ‘rthī lekhayet sadyaḥ pratijñātārthasādhamak | [Y 2.7cd]
tatsiddhau siddhim āpnoti viparītam ato ‘nyathā || [Y 2.8ab]
arthī vādī prativādīca | sadya iti – tena pramāṇanirdeśe pramāṇapravartane ca na kālātipātaḥ kārya ity arthaḥ | tad āha kātyāyanaḥ —
169 na kālaharaṇaṃ kāryaṃ rājñā sākṣiprabhāṣaṇe |
mahān doṣo bhavet kālād dharmavyāvṛttilakṣaṇaḥ || [K339]
sākṣiṇām upanyāse nigādane ca vilambo na kāryo ‘nyathā sākṣikaraṇasākṣisaṃghānādinā dharmalopāpattir ity arthaḥ |
kriyā ca dvividhā | tad āha bṛhaspatiḥ —
170 dviprakārā kriyā proktā mānuṣī daivikī tathā |
ekaikānekadhā bhinnā ṛṣibhis tattvavādibhiḥ || [B 4.6]
171 sākṣilekhānumānaṃ ca mānuṣī trividhā smṛtā | [B 4.8ab]
dhaṭādhyā dharmajāntā ca daivikī navadhā smṛtā || [4.7cd]
lekho bhogasyāpy upalakṣaṇam | dharmajāntāś ca navāpy anenaiva vakṣyante |
atra daivikī dvedhā, śapathadivyabhedāt | tad āha bṛhaspatiḥ –
172 satyaṃ vāhanaśastrāṇi gobījakāñcanāni ca |
devabrāhmaṇapādāś ca putradāraśirāṃsi ca || [8.33]
173 ete tu śapathāḥ proktāḥ svalpe ‘rthe sukarās tathā |
sāhaseṣv abhiśāpeṣu dviyāny āhur viśodhanam || [B 8.34]
halāyudhena tu divyaśapathayor abheda eva vyavasthāpitaḥ |
kātyāyanaḥ –
174 yadyeko mānuṣīṃ brūyād anyo brūyāt tu daivikīṃ |
mānuṣīṃ tatra gṛhṇīyān na tu daivīṃ kadācana || [K 218]
175 yady ekadeśavyāptāpi kriyā vidyeta mānuṣī |
sa grāhyā na tu pūrṇāpi daivikī vadatāṃ nṛṇām || [K 219]
ekadeśavyāptāpīti – stutir vā arthāntaravyāptaikadeśaviṣayakaṃ vā ekadeśavibhāvane ‘pi sarvaṃ dadyām iti paṇabandhaviṣayakaṃ vā |
176 kriyā na daivikī proktā vidyamāneṣu sākṣiṣu |
lekhye sati ca vādeṣu na syād divyaṃ na sākṣiṇaḥ || [K 223]
tathā –
177 anekārthābhiyoge tu yāvat saṃsādhayed dhanī |
sākṣibhis tāvad evāsau labhate sādhitaṃ dhanam || [K 473]
vastūnāṃ yatrānyonyāvinābhāvo nāsti tadviṣayam idam |
vyāsaḥ –
178 prāṅnyāyakāraṇoktau tu pratyarthī sādhayet kriyām |
mithyottare pūrvavādī pratipattau na sā bhavet || [Vy 1.29]
179 mithyā kriyā pūrvavāde kāraṇe prativādinaḥ |
prāṅnyāyavidhisiddhau ca jayapattraṃ vinirdiśet || [Vy ?]
mithyā mithyottare sati pūrvavādinaḥ kriyā sā ca mānuṣī grāhyā | na gṛhītaṃ mayety atra hi pratyarthinaḥ sā na bhavatīti nyāyo ‘tra mūlam | na cābhāvo na bodhya ity ato ‘trāpi bhāvasyaiva bodhyatā, abhiśāpe abhāvasyaiva parīkṣaṇāt | etena sukaratvāt prathamopasthitatvāc ca bhāvabhodhanam ity apāstam |
na ca kriyāpadaṃ yāvadarthakaṃ prāṅnyāyakāraṇayor anvīyate tāvadarthakam eva mithyottare ‘py anuṣajyate | tena mithyottare ‘rthina evādṛṣṭam apīti vācyam | śrūyamāṇaśabde punar anvayamātram eva hy anuṣaṅgo na tv arthāvaiṣamyasahitaṃ gauravāt |
tadabhāve tu daivī | tad āha yājñavalkyaḥ –
180 pramāṇaṃ likhitaṃ bhuktiḥ sākṣiṇaś ceti kīrtitam |
eṣām anyatamābhāve divyānyatamam ucyate || [Y 2.22]
sā prativādinaḥ –
181 na kaścid abhiyoktāraṃ punar divye niyojayet |
abhiyuktāya dātavyaṃ divyaṃ divyaviśāradaiḥ || iti [K 244 = 411]
vākyasya divyaprāptau pūrvārdhenābhiyoktus tanniṣedhe ‘rthato ‘bhiyojyasya tadvidhāv uttarārdhena tanniyamanāt | siddhe saty ārambhasya niyamārthatvāt | tasya tu saṃdihānatve * pāpitve vā tacchūnyasyārthina evānanyagatikatvāt | śaucaniścayayos taulye svecchasya rucyā vānyataraḥ kuryād iti vacanāt | icchātaulye pratyarthina eva, abhiyuktāyetyādivacanād eveti saṃkṣepaḥ |
balavatkāraṇottare tu prativādinaḥ kriyety āha kātyāyanaḥ —
182 prapadya kāraṇaṃ pūrvam anyad gurutaraṃ yadi |
prativākyagataṃ brūyāt sādhyate tad dhi netarat || [K 191]
dhāryamāṇatvasya kāraṇaṃ ṛṇagrahaṇaṃ bhāṣitam abhyupagamya tadādharyanimittaṃ uttaravākyagataṃ yadi gurutaraṃ kāraṇaṃ pariśodhanādikaṃ brūyāt tadā prativādinā tat sādhyate na tv itarat samabalam alpabalaṃ vety arthaḥ |
tathā –
183 arthinābhihito yo ‘rthaḥ pratyarthī yadi taṃ tathā |
prapadya kāraṇaṃ brūyād ādharyaṃ bhṛgur abravīt || [K 170]
kāraṇaṃ bhāṣitasya bādhakāraṇam | ādharyaṃ pūrvapakṣasyeti śeṣaḥ |
nāradaḥ —
184 ādharyaṃ pūrvapakṣasya yasminn arthavaśād bhavet |
vivāde sākṣiṇas tatra praṣṭavyāḥ prativādinaḥ || [N 1.164]
sākṣiṇa iti dṛṣṭādṛṣṭakriyopalakṣaṇam |
samabalakāraṇābhidhāne tu pūrvavādina eva kriyety āha nāradaḥ —
185 dvayor vivadator arthaṃ dvayoḥ satsu ca sākṣiṣu |
pūrvavādo bhaved yasya bhaveyus tasya sākṣiṇaḥ || [N 1.163]
yājñavalkyaḥ —
186 sākṣiṣūbhayataḥ satsu sākṣiṇaḥ pūrvavādinaḥ |
pūrvapakṣe ‘dharībhūte bhavanty uttaravādinaḥ || [Y 2.17]
idaṃ tūbhayavādisākṣiṇāṃ sarvathā sāmye, anyathājñāpatteḥ |
na ca —
187 samatvaṃ sākṣiṇāṃ yatra divyais tatra viśodhayed | [K 232ab]
iti kātyāyanavacanena saha virodhaḥ, tasyānyaviṣayatvāt | tathā hi yatraikatarasya vādinaḥ sākṣiṇāṃ parasparaviruddhaṃ nigadatāṃ nigadān na saṃśayocchedaḥ tatrādṛṣṭena nirṇayaḥ kārya iti tadarthatvāt |
vaiṣamye tu bṛhaspatiḥ —
188 sākṣidvaidhe prabhūtās tu grāhyāḥ sāmye guṇādhikāḥ |
guṇidvidhe kriyāyuktāḥ tatsāmye śucimattarāḥ || [B 5.46]
189 kriyā na daivikī proktā vidyamāneṣu sākṣiṣu |
lekhye sati ca vādeṣu na syād divyaṃ na sākṣiṇaḥ || [B 4.12]
svaṃ prāṅnyāye ‘pi prativadinaḥ pramāṇam āha vyāsaḥ —
190 prāṅnyāye jayapattreṇa prāḍvivākādibhis tathā |
satyavādi samāpnoti yad yat tena niveditam || [Vy 1.30]
bṛhaspatiḥ —
191 pratijñāṃ bhāvayed vādī pratyarthī kāraṇaṃ tathā |
prāgvṛttavādī vijayaṃ jayapattreṇa bhāvayet || [B 4.3]
pratijām iti – pratijñātahetuṃ gṛhītatvādikaṃ apahnutam arthī dṛṣṭena sādhayed ity arthaḥ | kāraṇaṃ valavatkāraṇaṃ pratyarthī dṛṣṭenādṛṣṭena vā bhāvayet |
atha prasaṅgāj jayapattralakṣaṇam |
tatra kātyāyanaḥ |
192 arthipratyarthivākyāni pratijñā sākṣivāk tathā |
nirṇayaś ca tathā tasya yathā vāvadhṛtaṃ svayam || [K 259]
193 etad yathākṣaraṃ lekhyaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ niveśayet |
sabhāsadaś ca ye tatra dharmaśāstravidas tathā || [K 260]
bṛhaspatiḥ —
194 yadvṛttaṃ vyavahārāt tu pūrvapakṣottarādikam |
kriyāvadhāraṇopetaṃ jayapattre ‘khilaṃ likhet || [B 6.27]
195 pūrvottarakriyāyuktaṃ nirṇayāntaṃ tadā nṛpaḥ |
pradadyāj jayine lekhyaṃ jayapattraṃ tad ucyate || [B 6.26]
vasiṣṭhaḥ —
196 yathopanyastasādhyārthasaṃyuktaṃ sottarādikam |
sāvadhāraṇakaṃ caiva jayapattram ucyate || [Va ?]
197 prāḍvivākādimudrāṅkaṃ mudritaṃ rājamudrayā |
tathā —
198 nirastā tu kriyā yatra pramāṇenaiva vādinā |
paścātkāro bhavet tatra na sarvāsu vidhīyate || [K 264cdef]
paścāt kriyata iti paścātkāro jayapattram |
yatra vādivākyatātparyālocanayā jayāvadhāraṇaṃ tatraiva jayapattraṃ na tv anyatreti kecit | tan na — pūrvajayavibhāvanasyānyatrāpi kṛtyatvena sarvatraiva jayapattrasya nyāyataḥ prāpter iti | bhāṣottare kriyā ca pattrasākṣyādikā nirṇayaś ca jayaparājayāvadhāraṇaṃ nirṇayakālāvasthitā madhyasthāś cetyādikaṃ sarvaṃ lekhanīyaṃ nirūpaṇasya samyaktvapradarśanārtham | bhāṣottaralekhanaṃ ca hetvantareṇa punarnyāye pratyavasthānanirāsārtham | na hi na gṛhītaṃ mayeti mithyottareṇa jitasya punaḥ pariśodhitaṃ mayeti pratyavasthānaṃ bhavati | tad āha kātyāyanaḥ —
199 kriyāṃ balavatīṃ tyaktvā durbalāṃ yo ‘valambate |
sa jaye ‘vadhṛte sabhyaiḥ punas tāṃ nāpnuyāt kriyām || [K 221]
200 nirṇīte vyavahāre tu pramāṇam aphalaṃ bhavet |
likhitaṃ sākṣiṇo vāpi pūrvam āveditaṃ na cet || [K? = NMā 1.62]
201 yathā pakveṣu dhānyeṣu niṣphalāḥ prāvṛṣo guṇāḥ |
nirṇītavyavahārāṇāṃ pramāṇam aphalaṃ tathā || [K? = NMā 1.63]
tyakveti — buddhipūrvakatyāgāvagateḥ tatra kriyāntarālābhaḥ |
atha grāhyakriyānirūpaṇam |
tatra kātyāyanaḥ —
202 anumānād guruḥ sākṣī sākṣibhyo likhitaṃ guru |
avyāhatā tripuruṣī bhuktir ebhyo garīyasī || [K 315]
anumānaṃ pratyākalitam | tad āha manuḥ —
203 bahyair vibhāvayet liṅgair bhāvam antargataṃ nṝṇām |
svaravarṇeṅgitākāraiś cakṣuṣā ceṣṭitena ca || [N 8.25]
svaro vikṛto gadgadatvādi | varṇo ‘py asvābhāvikaḥ | iṅgitaṃ svedavepathuromāñcādi | ākāro vikṛtaḥ | cakṣuṣā kātareṇa | ceṣṭitena sthānatyāgādinā | eṣāṃ cānanyathāsiddher atidurnirūpyatvāt ebhyaḥ sākṣī balvān ity arthaḥ |
tathā —
204 brūhīty uktaś ca na brūyād uktaṃ ca na vibhāvayet |
na ca pūrvāparaṃ vidyāt tasmād arthāt sa hīyate || [M 8.56]
205 santi jātāra ity uktvā diśety ukto diśen na yaḥ |
dharmasthaḥ kāraṇair etair hīnaṃ tam api nirdiśet || [M 8.57]
206 abhiyoktā na ced brūyāt vadhyo daṇḍyaś ca dharmataḥ |
na cet tripakṣād brūyāt sa dharmaṃ prati parājitaḥ || [M 8.58]
dharmastho vicārakaḥ | hīnaṃ saṃbhāvitahānikam | parājita iti — bhaṅgānanyathāsiddher atinipuṇenāvadhāraṇe sa parājito vyavahārya ity arthaḥ |
207 na pareṇa samuddiṣṭān upeyāt sākṣiṇo rahaḥ |
bhedayec caiva nānyena hīyetaivaṃ samācaret || [N 1.165]
208 palāyate ‘bhiyuktaś ca maunī sākṣiparājitaḥ |
svayam abhyupapannaś ca avasannaś caturvidhaḥ || [NMā 2.32]
209 anyavādī kriyādveṣī nopasthāyī niruttaraḥ |
āhūtaḥ prapalāyī ca hīnaḥ pañcavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ || [NMś 2.33]
upeyād upajāpārtham iti śeṣaḥ | anyena dūtādinā | palāyata iti — atrāvasannacatuṣṭayamadhye ādyau saṃbhāvitabhaṅgau antyo nirṇītabhaṅgau |
kātyāyanaḥ —
210 lekhayitvā tu yo vākyaṃ nyūnam abhyadhikaṃ punaḥ |
vaded vādī sa hīyeta nābhiyogaṃ tu so ‘rhati || [K 197]
etac ca pūraṇasamayātikrame jñeyam |
bṛhaspatiḥ —
211 sākṣiṇas tu samuddiśya yas tu tān na nigādayet |
triṃśadrātrāt tripakṣād vā hānis tasyopajāyate || [B 3.33]
atra kāryagauravalāghavābhyāṃ samayavikalpaḥ |
nāradaḥ —
212 sarveṣv atha vivādeṣu vākchale nāvasīdati |
paśustrībhūmyṛṇādāne śāsyo ‘py arthān na hīyate || [NMā 2.25]
paśvādivivādeṣu hānihetubhiḥ śāsyatām āpanno ‘pi na hīyate na parājita ity arthaḥ |
bṛhaspatiḥ —
213 ācārakaraṇe divye kṛtvopasthānanirṇayam |
nopasthito bhaved vādī chalaṃ tatra na kārayet || [B 3.40]
214 daivarājakṛto doṣas tasmin kāle yadā bhavet |
avadhityāgamātreṇa na bhavet sa parājitaḥ || [B 3.41]
ācāro vyavahāraḥ | chalaṃ parājayam |
daiveti — anupasthāne bhaṅgabhaṅgīkṛtyāpi daivāder anupasthitaasyāpi na bhaṅga ity arthaḥ |
tathā —
215 pūrvottare niviṣṭe tu vicāre saṃpravartite |
praśamaṃ ye mitho yānti dāpyās te dviguṇaṃ damam || [B 3.42]
ye vādino vicāram āruhya parasparaṃ samācaranti te vivādapadād dviguṇaṃ daṇḍyāḥ |
etac cānumānam atinipuṇastheyavedyatayā na sakalākalanīyam ato durbalam |
ato ‘pi divyaṃ durbalam | tad āha kātyāyanaḥ —
216 pramāṇair hetunā vāpi divyenaiva tu nirṇayam |
sarveṣv eva vivādeṣu sadā kuryān narādhipaḥ || [K 241]
217 pūrvābhāve tu yatnena nānyathaiva kadācana || [K 243ab]
parmāṇair bhuktilikhitasākṣibhiḥ | hetunā anumānena | evaṃ ca bhuktilikhitasākṣyanumānadviyānāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ balavat uttarottaram abalam iti pūrvalābhe sati nottarādara ity arthaḥ |
kātyāyanaḥ —
218 likhitaṃ sākṣiṇo bhuktiḥ pramāṇaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam |
leśoddeśaś ca yuktiś ca divyānīha viṣādayaḥ || [K 214]
219 ṛṇe lekhyaṃ sākṣiṇo vā yuktileśādayo ‘pi vā |
daivikī vā kriyā proktā prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā || [K 233]
leśo ‘nyathānupapanno dharmas tasyoddeśaḥ parāmarṣaḥ | tena parāmṛṣyamāṇo ‘nyathānupapanno dharma ity arthaḥ |
pitāmahaḥ —
220 sthāvareṣu vivādeṣu divyāni parivarjayet |
sākṣibhir likhitenātha bhuktvā vā tān prasādhayet || [Pi 39]
idaṃ tu sākṣyādīnām atra prāyikatayā tadādaraṇārtham | tadabhāve tu divyam api kāryam anyathā saṃdehatādavasthyāt |
kātyāyanaḥ —
221 vākpāruṣye ca bhūmau ca divyaṃ na parikalpayet || [K 239]
222 dattvādatte tathādatte svāmināṃ nirṇaye sati |
vikrīyādānasaṃbandhe krītvā dhanam anicchati || [K 227]
223 dyūte samāhvaye caiva vivāde samupasthite |
sākṣiṇaḥ sādhanaṃ proktaṃ na divyaṃ na ca lekhyakam || [K 228]
224 pūgaśreṇīgaṇādīnāṃ yā sthitiḥ parikalpitā |
tasyās tu sādhanaṃ lekhyaṃ na divyaṃ na ca sākṣiṇaḥ || [K 225]
225 dvāramārgakriyābhogajalavāhādike tathā |
bhuktir eva tu gurvī syāt na lekhyaṃ na ca sākṣiṇaḥ || [K 226]
226 prakrānte sāhase vāde pāruṣye daṇḍavācike |
balodbhūteṣu kāryeṣu sākṣiṇo divyam eva vā || [K 229]
dattvādatta iti — dātuṃ pratiśrutyānarpite | tathādatte dattvā punar ācchidya gṛhīte | svāmināṃ nirṇaye sati etatsvāmikam etad iti nirṇaye sati | dattvādattādivivāde sākṣiṇaḥ pramāṇaṃ na divyaṃ na ca lekhyam iti saṃbandhaḥ | dhanaṃ mūlyadhanam | anicchati dātum iti śeṣaḥ | dvāramārgakriyā dvāreṇa jalaniḥsaraṇādikriyā dvārakriyā mārgeṇa gavādīnāṃ niḥsaraṇādikriyā mārgakriyā | bhogo bhogyaṃ chatrādi | jalavāho jalanirgamamārgaḥ | ādipadād utkarādisaṃgrahaḥ | eṣu bhuktir gurvī |
pitāmahaḥ —
227 yasmin yasmin vivāde tu sākṣiṇāṃ nāsti saṃbhavaḥ |
sāhaseṣu ca sarveṣu tatra divyāni dāpayet || [Pi 29]
sāhaseṣu prāṇāntikadaṇḍārheṣu |
tathā ca kātyāyanaḥ —
228 samatvaṃ sākṣiṇāṃ yatra divyais tatra viśodhayet |
prāṇāntikavivāde ca vidyamāneṣu sākṣiṣu || [K 232abcd]
nāradaḥ —
229 pramāṇāni pramāṇajñaiḥ pālanīyāni yatnataḥ |
sīdanti hi pramāṇāni puruṣasyāparādhataḥ || [N 1.68]
aparādhaḥ sākṣyādīnām asmaraṇādiḥ |
atha prāyaśaḥ sākṣibhir vyavahārasamāptes te nirūpyante |
tatra gautamaḥ —
230 vipratipattau sākṣinimittā vyavasthā | [G 13.1]
prāyeṇeti śeṣaḥ |
manuḥ —
231 samakṣadarśanāt sākṣī śravanāc caiva sidhyati | [M 8.7ab]
samakṣeti pramitārthaḥ sākṣī bhavatīty arthaḥ |
bṛhaspatiḥ —
232 likhito lekhito gūḍhaḥ smāritaḥ kulyadūtakau
yādṛcchikaś cottaraś ca kāryamadhyagatas tathā || [B 5.4]
233 nṛpo ‘dhyakṣas tathā grāmaḥ sākṣī dvādaśadhā smṛtaḥ |
prabhedam eṣāṃ vakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ || [B 5.5]
234 jātināmābhilikhitaṃ yena svaṃ pitṛnāma ca |
nivāsaś ca sa vijñeyaḥ sākṣī likhitasaṃjñakaḥ || [B 5.6]
235 arthinā ca kriyābhedais tasya kṛtvā ṛṇādikam |
pratyakṣaṃ likhyate yas tu lekhitaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥ || [B 5.7]
236 kuḍyavyavahito yaś ca śrāvyate ṛṇibhāṣitam |
vinihnute yathābhūtaṃ gūḍhasākṣī sa kīrtitaḥ || [B 5.8]
237 āhūya yaḥ kṛtaḥ sākṣī ṛṇanyāsakriyādike |
smāryate ‘tha muhur yaś ca smāritaḥ so ‘bhidhīyate || [B 5.9]
238 vibhāgadāne vipaṇe jñātir yatropadiśyate |
dvayoḥ samāno dharmajñaḥ kulyaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ || [B 5.10]
239 arthipratyarthivacanaṃ śṛṇuyāt preṣitas tu yaḥ |
ubhayoḥ saṃmataḥ sādhur dūtakaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥ || [B 5.11]
240 kriyamāṇe ca kartavye yaḥ kaścit svayam āgataḥ |
atra sākṣitvam asmākam ukto yādṛcchikas tu saḥ || [B 512]
241 yaḥ sākṣī tu diśaṃ gacchan mumurṣur vā yathāśrutam |
anyaṃ saṃśrāvayet taṃ tu vidyād uttarasākṣiṇam || [B 5.13]
242 sākṣiṇām api yaḥ sākṣyam upary upari bhāṣatām |
śravaṇāt śrāvaṇād vāpi sa sākṣy uttarasaṃjñitaḥ || [B 5.14]
243 ubhābhyāṃ yasya viśvastaṃ kāryaṃ vā viniveditam |
gūḍhacārī sa vijñeyaḥ kāryamadhyagatas tathā || [B 5.15]
244 arthipratyarthinor vākyaṃ yac chrutaṃ bhūbhṛtā svayam |
sa eva tatra sākṣī syād visaṃvāde dvayor api || [B 5.16]
245 nirṇīte vyavahāre tu punar nyāyo yadā bhavet |
adhyakṣaḥ sabhyasahitaḥ sākṣī syāt tatra nānyathā || [B 5.17]
246 dūṣitaṃ ghātitaṃ yat tu sīmāyās tu samantataḥ |
akṛto ‘pi bhavet sākṣī grāmas tatra na saṃśayaḥ || [B 5.18]
atra sākṣī dvividhaḥ — draṣṭā śrotā ca | tatra dvāv api ṣaḍvidhau | tatrādyo likhitalekhitasmāritakulyayādṛcchikakāryamadhyagatabhedāt ṣoḍhā | antyo ‘pi gūḍhadūtottarasākṣigrāmādhyakṣarājabhedāt ṣoḍhaiva | tatra prathamaṣaṭke ādyasya lakṣaṇam – jātīyādi | kriyādarśī svayaṃ likhitasvasākṣyo likhitasākṣīty arthaḥ | dvitīyasya tu – arthinetyādi | kriyādarśī vaṇigādilikhito lekhita ity arthaḥ | tṛtīyasya tu – āhūyetyādi | kriyādarśī tadbodhitasaṃskāraḥ. smārita ityarthaḥ | caturthasy – vibhāgetyādi | kriyādarśī dhanikādisanābhiḥ kulya ity arthaḥ | pañcamasya tu – kriyamāṇetyādi | kriyādarśī atiraskṛtāpuraskṛto yādṛcchika ityarthaḥ | ṣaṣṭhasya tu – ubhābhyām ityādi | tatkriyāvyavahārāntargatas tatkriyādarśi kāryamadhyagata ityarthaḥ | atra viśvastaṃ viśvāsaḥ kṛtaḥ | vākāraḥ samuccaye | yady api kāryavinivedanāt śruto sākṣy asau tathāpi kāryamadhyagatatvaṃ puraskṛtya draṣṭur varge gaṇita ity avadheyam | uttaraṣaṭke tu prathamasya lakṣaṇam – kuḍyetyādi | abhiyuktājñātaḥ sann abhiyoktrabhihitābhiyuktavākyaśrāvī gūḍhasākṣītyarthaḥ | dvitīyasya tu – arthītyādi | preṣito nirṇayakṣamavādivākyaśrāvi dūta ityarthaḥ | tṛtīyasya tu – ya ityādiślokadvayam | sākṣivacanāt tadarthaniścayavān uttarasākṣīty arthaḥ | caturthasya tu – arthītyādi | bhāṣottaraśrāvī aparaḥ sākṣīty arthaḥ | asya tu bhāṣādhyapahnave sati pūrvabhāṣādyabhijñatayā nirṇāyakatvam | pañcamasya tu – nirṇīta ityādi | pūrvajayajñaḥ pañcamaḥ sākṣīty arthaḥ | ṣaṣṭhasya tu – dūṣitaṃ ityādi | abhiyogahetubhūtopaghātadraṣṭā uphantavyasīmāsetvādiśrotā grāmādisthāḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ sākṣīty arthaḥ |
prajāpatiḥ |
247 sākṣī tu dvividho jñeyaḥ kṛta eko ‘paro ‘kṛtaḥ |
lekhyārūḍhaḥ kṛto jñeyo muktako ‘kṛta ucyate || iti | [Pr ?]
nāradaḥ |
248 ekādaśavidhaḥ sākṣī śāstre dṛṣṭo manīṣibhiḥ |
kṛtaḥ pañcavidhas teṣāṃ ṣaḍvidho ‘kṛta ucyate || [N 1.149]
249 likhitaḥ smāritaś caiva yadṛcchābhijña eva ca |
gūḍhaś cottarasākṣī ca sākṣī pañcavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ || [N 1.150]
250 anye punar anirdiṣṭāḥ sākṣiṇaḥ samudāhṛtāḥ |
grāmaś ca prāḍvivakaś ca rājā ca vyavahāriṇām || [N 1.151]
251 kāryeṣv abhyantaro yaś ca arthinā prahitaś ca yaḥ |
kulyāḥ kulavivādeṣu bhaveyus te ‘pi sākṣiṇaḥ || [N 1.152]
likhitasyaiva svayaṃ pareṇa lekhanāt bṛhaspatinā dvādaśasākṣiṇa uktāḥ |
yat tu –
252 na kāryo nṛpatiḥ sākṣī na kārur na kuśīlavaḥ | [M 8.65ab]
iti manuvacanaṃ tad rājñaḥ sākṣitvakaraṇaniṣedhakaṃ na tu sākṣitvaniṣedhakam | ato na virodhaḥ |
nāradaḥ |
253 sudīrghenāpi kālena likhitaḥ siddhim āpnuyāt |
saṃjānann ātmano lekhyam ajānantaṃ lekhayet || [N 1.167]
sudīrgheneti – saṃskārodbodhakalikhanasattvād ayaṃ cireṇāpi sākṣyaṃ dātuṃ śaknotīty arthaḥ |
saṃjānann iti – lipipaṭuṃ śākṣiṇaṃ taddhastenaiva lekhayet | tad apaṭuṃ tu parahasteneti viśeṣa ity arthaḥ |
atha sākṣyārhāḥ |
tatra manuḥ |
254 yādṛśā arthibhiḥ kāryā vyavahāreṣu sākṣiṇaḥ |
tādṛśān saṃpravakṣyāmi yathā vācyam ṛtaṃ ca taiḥ || [N 8.61]
255 gṛhiṇaḥ putriṇo maulāḥ kṣatravitśūdrayonayaḥ |
arthyuktāḥ sākṣyam arhanti na y ekecid anāpai || [M 8.62]
256 āptāḥ sarveṣu varṇeṣu karyāḥ kāryeṣu sākṣiṇaḥ |
sarvadharmavido ‘lubdhā viparītāṃs tu varjayet || [M 8.63]
ṛtaṃ satyam | maulāḥ prasiddhakulodbhavāḥ | na ye kecid iti – guṇavatsākṣyabhāve nirdoṣatāmātreṇāpi sākṣiṇo grāhyā ity arthaḥ |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
257 tapasvino dānaśīlāḥ kulīnāḥ satyavādinaḥ |
dharmapradhānā ṛjavaḥ putravanto dhanānvitāḥ || [Y 2.68]
258 tryavarāḥ sākṣiṇo jñeyāḥ śrautasmārtakriyānvitāḥ |
yathājāti yathāvarṇaṃ sarve sarveṣu vā smṛtāḥ || [Y 2.69]
yathājātīty saṃkīrṇajātyabhiprāyam, yathāvarṇam iti brāhmaṇādivarṇānām upādānāt | yad vā – yathājātīti strīṇāṃ striya ityevamādi | evaṃ ca saṃkhyāguṇādisāmye ‘pi yasya vādinaḥ savarṇāḥ sākṣiṇas tasyaiva grāhyā iti bhāvaḥ |
manuḥ |
259 strīṇāṃ sākṣyaṃ striyaḥ kuryur dvijānāṃ sadṛśā dvijāḥ |
śūdrāh santaś ca śūdrāṇām antyānām antyayonayaḥ || [M 8.68]
nāradaḥ |
260 kulīnā ṛjavaḥ śuddhā janmataḥ karmato ‘rthataḥ |
tryavarāḥ sākṣiṇo jñeyāḥ śucayaḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ || [N 1.153]
261 brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā ye cāpy aninditāḥ |
prativarṇaṃ bhaveyus te sarve sarveṣu vā punaḥ || [M 1.154]
tryavarāḥ trayo ‘varā yeṣāṃ te tryavarāḥ | tena tribhya ārabhya navaparyantāḥ sākṣiṇaḥ | yad āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
262 nava sapta pañca vā syuś catvāras traya eva vā |
ubhau tu śrotriyau grāhyau naikaṃ pṛcchet kadācana || [B 5.1]
ubhau tv iti – pūrvoktaguṇeṣu satsv eva śrotriyau cet tadobhāv api grāhyau ekas tu śrotriyo ‘pi na grāhya ity arthaḥ | śrotriyāv iti – tryavarasākṣyapekṣayotkṛṣṭaguṇāv ity arthaḥ |
śaṅkhaḥ |
263 ekaḥ sākṣī sarvathā na grāhyaḥ | [ŚL ?]
guṇavato ‘py agrahaṇam iti sarvathāpad asyārthaḥ |
etac cobhayānanumataviṣayam | ubhayānumatas tv eko ‘pi nigādya eva | tad āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
264 ubhayānumataḥ sākṣī bhaved eko ‘pi dharvit | iti | [Y 2.72ab]
dharmavid iti sakalasākṣiguṇopalakṣaṇam |
nāradaḥ |
265 ubhayānumato yaḥ syāt dvayor vivadamānayoḥ |
bhavatv eko ‘pi sākṣitve praṣṭavyaḥ syāt tu saṃsadi || [N 1.192]
ubhayānumata iti – ubhayānumativiṣaya ity arthaḥ | na tūbhayānumatiyogyo, lakṣaṇāpatteḥ | tapasvina ityādinā ca guṇavatām eva tryavaratvavidhānāt | yogyatālakṣakatve cānumatipadam anarthakam eva syāt, dharmavitpadād evānumatiyogyasya prāptatvād iti | etad eva vyaktam āha viṣṇuḥ |
266.267 atha sākṣiṇaḥ | kulavṛttajātisampannā yajvānas tapasvinaḥ putriṇo dharmajñā
268 adhīyānāḥ satyavantas traividyavṛddhā abhimataguṇasampannas tūbhayānumat
eko ‘pi || [Vi 8.1, 8,9]
ekasya sākṣitve abhimataguṇasampatty ubhayānumatī milite tantram | yat tu – bhinne ime tantram | tena nirguṇasyāpi sadoṣasyāpy ubhyayānumatasyaikasya sākṣyam eveti | tan na – evam arthabhedād vākyabhedāpatter iti |
vyāsaḥ |
269 śucikriyaś ca dharmajñaḥ sākṣī yatrānubhūtavāk |
pramāṇam eko ‘pi bhavet sāhaseṣu viśeṣataḥ || [Vy 1.90]
anubhūtā vāk satyatvena yasa sa tathā |
kātyāyanaḥ |
270 abhyantaras tu nikṣepe sākṣyam eko ‘pi vācyate |
arthinā prahitaḥ sākṣī bhaved eko ‘pi yācite || [K 353]
yācita iti nikṣepaviśeṣaṇam | nyāyataulyād anyatrāpi |
tathā |
271 saṃskṛtaṃ yena yat paṇyaṃ tat tenaiva vibhāvayet |
eka eva pramāṇaṃ sa vivāde parikīrtitaḥ || [K 354]
saṃskṛtaṃ ghaṭitam | paṇyaṃ kuṇḍalādi | etac ca tādṛśasyānyasyābhāve tasya ca steyatvapakṣe draṣṭavyam |
manuḥ |
272 eko ‘py alubdhaḥ sākṣī syāt bahvyaḥ śucyo ‘pi na striyaḥ |
strībuddher asthiratvāt tu doṣair anyaiś ca ye vṛtāḥ || [M 8.77]
pramāṇasiddhe tu tulyatve ubhayānumato ‘pi sākṣī na grāhyaḥ | lubdhatvaṃ tu doṣamātropalakṣaṇam |
atha sākṣyānarhāḥ |
tatra nāradaḥ |
273 asakṣy api hi śāstreṣu dṛṣṭaḥ pañcavidho budhaiḥ |
vacanād doṣato bhedāt svayamuktir mṛtāntaraḥ || [N 1.157]
274 śrotriyādyā vacanataḥ stenādyā doṣadarśanāt |
bhedād vipratipattiḥ syād vivāde yatra sākṣiṇām || [N 1.157?]
275 rājñā parigṛhīteṣu sākṣiṣv ekārthanirṇaye |
vacanaṃ yatra bhidyeta te syur bhedād asākṣiṇaḥ || [N 1.160]
asyārthaḥ – ekasya bhāṣārthasya uttarārthasya vā nirṇayārthaṃ gṛhītānāṃ sākṣiṇāṃ vacanabhedād asākṣitvam iti | etac ca sākṣiṇāṃ sarvathātaulyavacanabhede boddhavyam | anyathā tu –
276 bahutvaṃ parigṛhṇīyāt sākṣidvaidhe narādhipaḥ |
sameṣu ca guṇotkṛṣṭān guṇidvaidhe dvijottamān || [M 8.73]
iti manuvacanād eva vyavasthā | na cedaṃ sākṣyupādānamātraparam, parigṛhṇīyād iti vacanāt | na tu tadvacanaprāmāṇyaparam iti vācyam, parigrahānarthakyāpatteḥ | nāpi vādinor eva sākṣidvaidhe satīdam, ekasyāpi vādinaḥ sākṣibhede ‘sya saṃkocena jāgarukatvāt |
yājñavalkyo ‘py āha |
277 dvaidhe bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ sameṣu guṇināṃ tathā |
guṇidvaidhe tu vacanaṃ grāhyaṃ ye guṇavattarāḥ || [Y 2.78]
na cedaṃ vacanapadaṃ manvanurodhāt parigrahaparam, nirbījalakṣaṇāpatteḥ |
atha —
278 sākṣiṇāṃ likhitānāṃ ca nirdiṣṭānāṃ ca vādinām |
teṣām eko ‘nyathāvādī bhedāt sarve ‘py asākṣiṇaḥ || [K 359]
iti kātyāyanavacanena ekasyāpy anyathāvāde sarveṣām asakṣitvam ucyata iti virodha iti cet | na — trayāṇāṃ sākṣiṇāṃ madhye ekasyānyathāvāde ‘parasya tattulyasya satpratipakṣitatayā tṛtīyasya caikatayā tatra sākṣito na nirṇīyata ity atra kātyāyanatātparyāt | satpratipakṣitāvaśiṣṭānāṃ tv anekatve tata eva nirṇaya ity atra yājñavalkyatātparyād iti kātyāyanavacanasya cāsya svamūlabhūtanyāyavirodhenārabhya saṃkocyatvād iti |
svayam uktaṃ vyākaroti nāradaḥ |
279 svayamuktir anirdiṣṭaḥ svayam evaitya yo vadet | [N 1.157ab]
kātyāyano ‘pi |
280 yaḥ sākṣī naiva nirdiṣṭo nāhūto naiva deśitaḥ |
brūyān mithyeti tathyaṃ vā daṇḍyaḥ so ‘pi narādhamaḥ || [K 404]
mṛtāntaraṃ vivinakti nāradaḥ |
281 mṛtāntaro ‘rthini prete mumūrṣuśrāvitād ṛte || [N 1.157cd]
arthī dhanikaḥ | mumūrṣuṇā dhanikena yaḥ sākṣī svadāyādebhyo ‘yam iyad dhanaṃ mahyaṃ dhārayaty ayaṃ tu jānātīti śrāvitaḥ sa mṛtāntaro ‘pi sākṣī bhavaty evety arthaḥ |
mṛtāntarasya tv asākṣitve hetum āha sa eva |
282 yo ‘rthaḥ śrāvayitavyaḥ syāt tasminn asati cārthini |
kva taduttarasākṣitvam ity asākṣī mṛtāntaraḥ || [N 1.162]
arthinā sākṣiṇi yo ‘rtho vivādāspadībhūtaḥ śrāvayitavyaḥ tvam imam arthaṃ jānīhīti tasmin śrāvayitavye ‘rthe śrāvayitari arthini asati aśrutatvād arthaviśeṣasya kvārthe sākṣī sākṣitvaṃ vadata iti hetor mṛtāntaro na sākṣīty arthaḥ |
tenaitad uktaṃ bhavati – yasminn arthe ‘rthini prete arthiputrasya na viśeṣajñānaṃ tatra sākṣiṇaḥ tatsattve ‘pi na sākṣitvaṃ saviśeṣam anupanyāsāt sāmānyopanyastasyāpi tasya sākṣiṇo na saṃkhyādau viśeṣe sākṣitvaṃ svayamuktitvāpatteḥ | kiṃ tūbhayor arthisākṣiṇor upayuktāśeṣajñatāyām eva mṛtāntaraḥ sākṣīti bhāvaḥ |
śrotriyādīn vyākaroti sa eva |
283 śrotriyās tāpasā vṛddhā ye ca pravrajitā narāḥ |
asākṣiṇas te vacanāt nātra hetur udāhṛtaḥ || [N 1.158]
vacanād iti – teṣāṃ sākṣitvakāraṇaniṣedhakavacanāt | tathā ca te pūjyatamatayā tapaścaryāvyāsaktatvena vivādapadavismaraṇaśīlatayā na sākṣiṇaḥ kāryāḥ | akṛtās tu tattvaṃ jānanto bhavanty eva sākṣiṇaḥ | tad yuktam – ubhau tu śrotriyau grāhyāv iti | nātra hetur iti – nārtoktānyahetur ity arthaḥ |
doṣād asākṣiṇo darśayati nāradaḥ |
284 stenāḥ sāhasikāś caṇḍāḥ kitavo vyādhakās tathā |
asākṣiṇas te duṣṭatvāt teṣu satyaṃ na vidyate || [N 1.159]
manuḥ |
285 nārthasaṃbandhino nāptā na sahāyā na vairiṇaḥ |
na dṛṣṭadoṣāḥ kartavyā na vyādhyārthā na dūṣitāḥ || [N 8.64]
arthasaṃbandhī jayaphalabhāgī | āptaḥ sahāyo ripuś ca yo yasya |
nāradaḥ |
286 dāsanaikṛtikāśraddhavṛddhastrībālacākrikāḥ |
mattonmattapramattārtakitavā grāmayājakāḥ || [N 1.178]
287 mahāpathikasāmudravaṇikpravrajitāturāḥ |
vyaṅgaikaśrotriyācārahīnaklībakuśīlavāḥ || [N 1.179]
288 nāstikavrātyadārāgnityāgino ‘yājyayājakāḥ |
ekasthālīsahāyāricarajñātisanābhayaḥ || [1.180]
289 prāgdṛṣṭadoṣaśaulūṣaviṣajīvyāhituṇḍikāḥ |
garadāgnidakīnāśaśūdrāputropapātitāḥ || [N 1.181]
290 klāntasāhasikāśrāntanirdhūtāgnyavasāyinaḥ |
bhinnavṛttāsamāvṛttajalatailakamūlikāḥ || [N 1.182]
291 bhūtāviṣṭanṛpadviṣṭavarṣanakṣatrasūcakāḥ |
aghaśaṃsyātmavikretṛhīnāṅgabhagavṛttayaḥ || [N 1.183]
292 kunakhiśyāvadacchvitrimitradhrukśaṭhaśauṇḍikāḥ |
aindrajālikalubdhograśreṇīgaṇavirodhinaḥ || [N 1.184]
293 vadhakaś citrakṛc chaṅkhaḥ patitaḥ kūṭakārakaḥ |
kuhakaḥ pratyavasitas taskaro rājapūruṣaḥ || [N 1.185]
294 manuṣyapaśumāṃsāsthimadhukṣīrāmbusarpiṣām |
vikratā brāhmaṇaś caiva dvijo vārddhuṣikaś ca yaḥ || [N 1.186]
295 cyutaḥ svadharmāt kulikaḥ sūcako hīnasevakaḥ |
pitrā vivadamānaś ca bhedakaś cety asākṣiṇaḥ || [N 1.187]
296 śreṇyādiṣu ca vargeṣu kaścic ced dveṣyatām iyāt |
tasya tebhyo na sākṣyaṃ syāt dveṣṭāraḥ sarva eva te || [N 1.156]
naikṛtikā vañcakāḥ | aśraddhaḥ śraddhāhīnaḥ | vṛddho glānendriyaḥ | strī puṃsāṃ na sākṣiṇī | bālo ‘jātavivekaḥ |
mahāpathiko dīrghādvagāmī | āturo tirogapīḍitaḥ | ekaḥ śrotriyaḥ dvayoḥ śrotriyayor vihitatvāt so ‘py ananumataḥ | klībaṃ napuṃsakam | kuśīlavo raṅgopajīvī |
ekasthālīsahāya ekapākabhojī | aricaro vādiśatrucārī | sanābhayas tu –
297 mātṛṣvasṛsutās caiva sodaryasutamātulāḥ |
ete sanābhayas tūktāḥ sākṣyaṃ teṣu na vidyate | [K 362]
iti kātyāyanoktāḥ |
śailūṣo naṭabhinnaraṅgopajīvī vivakṣitaḥ | viṣajīvī viṣavaidyaḥ | āhituṇḍikaḥ sarpakrīḍopajīvī vyālagrāhī | garadāgnidau parāniṣṭhārthaṃ viṣāgniprayoktārau | kīnāśo hālikaḥ | upapātita upapātakādrāntaḥ |
klānto ‘tikhinnaḥ | atrānto ‘yogyakārī | nirdhūtaḥ grāmarājakulaśreṇyādibhir niḥsāritaḥ | lokabhayaśūnya iti kaścit | agnyavasāyī krodhādinā saṃskṛtāgninirvāpakaḥ | bhinnavṛttaḥ svakarmatyāgī | asamāvṛttaḥ akṛtasamāvartanaḥ | tailikaḥ tilavikrayī | mūlikaḥ mūlaṃ vipralambhas tatkārī |
aghaśaṃsī parābhiśāpaśīlaḥ | hīnāṅgaḥ prakṛtaparimāṇanyūnāṅgaḥ | śaṅkhaḥ vṛṣabhanāṭanena bhikṣāṭanaśīlaḥ | pratyavasitas tyaktapravrajyaḥ | kulikaḥ paricchedakatvena niyuktaḥ |
sarve caite mandābhidhāyino lobhādiśaṅkanāt | tathā ca manuḥ |
298 lobhān mohād bhayān maitrāt kāmāt krodhāt tathaiva ca |
ajñānād bālabhāvāc ca sākṣyaṃ vitatham ucyate || [M 8.118]
atra yady api sākṣiṇāṃ viśeṣavidhinaiva śeṣapratiṣedha iti kaṇṭhato niṣedho ‘narthakaḥ tathāpi vihitālābha ‘py amīṣām anupādānāya maudgaś carur bhavatīty ukte ‘py ayajñiyā vai māṣā itivat | tathā ca vihitālābhe avihitāniṣiddhāḥ sākṣiṇo grāhyāḥ kaṇṭhato niṣiddhās tu sarvathā na grāhyā ity āśayaḥ |
etac ca sākṣiparīkṣaṇam ṛṇādiṣu na tu sāhasādiṣu | yad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
299 ṛṇādiṣu parīkṣeta sākṣiṇaḥ sthirakarmasu |

pūrvam iti – pūrvam upanyastaṃ balavatpramāṇaṃ yat sākṣyādikaṃ vādinā dūratvādidoṣāt vyāpārayitum aśakitaṃ vicārakeṇāśakyatvabhrameṇāpuraskṛtya yatra durbalaṃ pramāṇam ādṛtaṃ tatra saptāhottaram api balavatpramāṇopasthitau tat punar vyāpāryam ity arthaḥ | idaṃ ca punardarśanaṃ vicārasya śakyavyāpāraṇe balavati pramāṇe aśakyavyāpāraṇatvabhrameṇa taddoṣajam | tad uktam –
439 sākṣisabhyāvasannānāṃ dūṣaṇe darśaṇaṃ punaḥ | iti | [NMā 2.40ab]
pradīpādayo ‘py evam eva |
atha likhitam |
tatra bṛhaspatiḥ |
440 ṣāṇmāsike ‘pi samaye bhrāntiḥ saṃjāyate yataḥ |
dhātrākṣarāṇi sṛṣṭāni pattrārūḍhāny ataḥ purā || [B 6.2]
nāradaḥ |
441 lekhyaṃ tu dvividhaṃ proktaṃ svahastānyākṣaraṃ tathā |
asākṣikaṃ sākṣimac ca siddhir deśasthites tayoḥ || [N 1.135]

tac ca ṛṇakrayabhāgadānavyavasthājayapattrabhedāt ṣoḍhā | dānapattram api dvedhā arājarājabhedāt | idaṃ ca ṣaḍvidham api sadasadbhedāt pratyekaṃ dvedhā |\
yājñavalkyaḥ |
442 vināpi sākṣibhir lekhyaṃ svahastalikhitaṃ tu yat |
tat pramāṇaṃ smṛtaṃ sarvaṃ balopādhikṛtād ṛte || [Y 2.89]

dvitīye nāradaḥ |
443 sākṣiṇaś ca svahastena pitṛnāmādipūrvakam |
atrāham amukaḥ sākṣī likheyur iti te samāḥ || [Y 2.87]

444 dattvā bhūmiṃ nibandhaṃ vā kṛtvā lekhyaṃ tu kārayet |
tatra cāgāminṛpatiparijñānāya pārthivaḥ || [Y 1.318]
445 paṭe vā tāmrapaṭṭe vā svamudroparicihnitam || [Y 1.319ab]
nibandha ākārādau niyatagrāhyam |
jayapatraṃ tūktaṃ prāk |

446 āhartā bhuktiyukto ‘pi lekhyadoṣān viśodhayet |
tatsuto bhuktidoṣāṃs tu lekhyadoṣāṃs tu nāpnuyāt || [K 323]
bṛhaspatiḥ |
447 uddharel lekhyam āhartā tatputro bhuktim eva tu |
abhiyuktaḥ pramītaś cet tatsuto ‘pi tad uddharet || [B 6.39]

kātyāyanaḥ |
448 dṛṣṭe pattre sphuṭaṃ doṣaṃ noktavān ṛṇiko yadi |
tato viṃśativarṣāṇi krāntaṃ pattraṃ sthiraṃ bhavet || [K 298]
449 śaktasya saṃnidhāv artho yasya lekhyena bhujyate |
varṣāṇi viṃśatiṃ yāvat tat pattraṃ doṣavarjitam || [K 299]
atha lekhyadaurbalyam |
tatra vyāsaḥ |
450 adṛṣṭāśrāvitaṃ lekhyaṃ pramītadhanikarṇikam |
abandhalagnakaṃ caiva bahukālaṃ na sidhyati || [Vy 1.69]
adarśitatvādisaptadoṣāśraye lekhyaṃ na pramāṇam ity arthaḥ |
asyāpavādam āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
451 unmattajaḍabālānāṃ rājabhītapravāsinām |
apragalbhabhayārtānāṃ na lekhyaṃ hānim āpnuyāt || [B 6.52]
unmattādīnāṃ lekhyam adarśitatvādinā na hānim āpnotīty arthaḥ |
atha bhuktiḥ |
tatra vyāsaḥ |
452 sāgamo dīrghakālaś ca niśchidro ‘nyaravojjhitaḥ |
pratyarthisaṃnidhānaś ca pañcāṅgo bhoga iṣyate || [Vy 1.84]
pramāṇam iti śeṣaḥ | āgacchati svībhavaty anenety āgamaḥ krayādiḥ tadvān | dīrghakālaḥ smṛtyuktakālānyūnakālaḥ | niśchidro nirantaraḥ | anyaravojjhitaḥ paravipratipattiprakāśaśūnyaḥ | pratyarthino vādyanyatarasya saṃnidhānaṃ yatra tādṛśaḥ |
nanu sāgamatvaṃ vyartham, tadrahitabhogasyāpi prāmāṇyāt | tad āha nāradaḥ |
453 anyāyena tu yad bhuktaṃ pitrā pūrvatarais tribhiḥ |
na tacchakyam apākartuṃ kramāt tripuruṣāgatam || [N 1.91]
454 yad vināpy āgamaṃ pūrvaṃ bhuktaṃ pūrvais tribhir bhavet |
na tac chakyam apākartuṃ kramāt tripuruṣāgatam || [N 1.93]
vyāsaḥ |
455 yad vināgamam atyantaṃ bhuktaṃ pūrvatarais tribhiḥ |
na tac chakyam apākartuṃ kramāt tripuruṣāgatam || [Vy 1.85]
tripuruṣabhogam āha vyāsaḥ |
456 prpitāmahena yad bhuktaṃ tatputreṇa ca taṃ vinā |
tau vinā yasya pitrā ca tasya bhogas tripūruṣaḥ || [Vy 1.83]
puruṣajīvanāniyamāt puruṣabhogaṃ paribhāṣate sa eva |
457 varṣāṇi viṃśatiṃ bhuktvā svāmināvyāhatā satī |
bhuktiḥ sā pauruṣī bhūmair dviguṇā ca dvipuruṣī |
tripuruṣī ca triguṇā na tatrāpekṣya āgamaḥ || [Vy 1.81]
evaṃ ca tripuruṣabhoga āgamanirapekṣa eva pramāṇam iti na, vacanāntaravirodhāt | tad āha viṣṇuḥ |
458 sāgamena tu bhogena bhuktaṃ samyag yadā bhavet |
āhartā labhate tatra nāpahāryas tu tat kvacit || [Vi 5.185]
āhartā bhoktā | apahāryas taddhanasvāmī |
459 pitrā bhuktaṃ tu yad dravyaṃ bhuktvācāreṇa dharmataḥ |
tasmin prete na vācyo ‘sau bhuktvā prāptaṃ hi tasya tat || [Vi 5.186]
460 tribhir eva tu yā bhuktā puruṣair bhūr yathāvidhi |
lekhyābhāve ‘pi tāṃ tatra caturthaḥ samavāpnuyāt || [Vi 5.187]
bhuktvācāreṇa niśchidratvādinā | yathāvidhi śaktasya saṃnihitasya virodhādikaṃ vinety arthaḥ |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
461 āgamena viśuddhena bhogo yāti pramāṇatām |
aviśuddhāgamo bhogaḥ prāmāṇyaṃ naiva gacchati || [Y?]
nārado ‘pi |
462 anāgamaṃ tu yo bhuṅkte bahūny abdaśatāni tu |
cauradaṇḍena taṃ pāpaṃ daṇḍayed avanīpatiḥ || [N 1.87]
hantaivaṃ virodhāt saṃśaya evāstv iti | na, viṣayabhedāt | tathā hi pūrveṣāṃ vacanānām āgamasaṃdeham uttareṣāṃ tu tadbhāvaniścayam ālambya pravṛtteḥ | tathā ca tripuruṣabhogasthale āgamasaṃśaye ‘pi bhogaḥ pramāṇam anyatra tv āgamaniścayasahita eveti siddham |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
463 paśyato ‘bruvato hānir bhūmer viṃśativārṣikī |
pareṇa bhujyamānāyā dhanasya daśavārṣikī || [Y 2.24]
dhanasya gavādeḥ |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
464 adhyāsanāt samārabhya bhuktir yasyāvighātinī |
triṃśadvarṣāṇy avacchinnā tasya tāṃ na vicālayet || [B 7.28]
adhyāsanaṃ krayādir āgamaḥ |
nanv anayor eva vacanayoḥ parasparavirodhaḥ triṃśadvarṣabhukteḥ prāmāṇyoktyā viṃśativarṣabhukter arthataḥ prāmāṇyanirāsād iti |
na, paśyato ‘bruvata ity abhidhānād yatra viruddhaṃ vāṅmātram api nāsti tatra viṃśativarṣabhoga eva pramāṇam, triṃśadvacane cāvighātinīti śruter vighātapadārthasya kalahatāḍanāder eva niṣedhāt vāṅmātravipratipattau satyām api triṃśadvarṣabhogo bhūsvatve pramāṇam ity avirodhāt | evaṃ cābhyāṃ vacanābhyāṃ gavādau nīravo daśavārṣiko bhogas tathā bhūmau tādṛśa eva viṃśativārṣikas tathā bhūmāv eva saravo ‘pi kalahādiśūnyaḥ triṃśadvārṣikabhogaḥ pramāṇam |
tat kathaṃ tripuruṣa evāsau pramāṇam ucyata iti tatra ratnākaraḥ – na hy uktavacanaṃ bhoktuḥ svatve pramāṇaṃ kiṃ tv anyatra | tathā hi paśyato ‘bruvata ityādes tādṛśasya bhoktuḥ pārśve gobhūmyādisvāminā tadbhogasaṃbandhena dhanaṃ na labhyata ity arthaḥ |
465 bhujyamānān parair arthāna yas tān mohād upekṣate |
samakṣaṃ paśyato ‘py asya tān bhuktiḥ kurute vaśaḥ || [N 1.78]
iti nāradavacanasyāpy asāv evārthaḥ |
pradīpas tu – ādher anupabhogena yatrāsiddhis tadviṣayaṃ paśyato ‘bruvata ityādivacanam | tena yatrādhigrahītrā ādheyaṃ bhūmyādi na bhujyate kiṃ tv ādhikartraiva ciraṃ bhuktvā anyatrādhīyate tatrottarasyādhigrahītus tatra bhūmyādau prabhutvaṃ na tu prathamasya | tathā ca yady api
466 ādhau pratigrahe krīte pūrvaiva balavattare | [Y 2.23cd]
ityādikam api vacanam asti, tathāpi tadapavādakaṃ paśyato ‘bruvata ityādivacanam | tathā cāpavādakabalāt dvitīyasyaivādhiḥ vidhyati | prapañco ‘py evam |
yad vā hānipadam evam upekṣituḥ pakṣe vicārakasya nyūnakoṭikaḥ saṃśayo bhavatīty evaṃparam | na tu hānir bhaṅga eva | tathā sati daṇḍam antareṇa punardarśanaṃ hīnasya gṛhyate vāda ityādivacanasiddhaṃ na ghaṭate | tasmāt tādṛśahānim ato ‘py asya punarvicanareṇaiva nirṇayaḥ kāryaḥ | ata eva –
467 upekṣitā yathā dhenur vinā pālena naśyati |
paśyato ‘nyais tathā bhuktā bhūmiḥ kālena hīyate || [Vy 1.76]
468 varṣāṇi viṃśatiṃ yasya bhūmir bhuktā parair iha |
sati rājñi samarthasya tasya seha na sidhyati || [Vy 1.77]
iti vyāsavacanayoḥ paśyantam anādṛtya yā yasya bhūḥ parair bhujyate sā tasya hīyate tadīyatvena na niścīyata iti ratnākare ‘pi vyākhyātam | kiṃ ca yadi viṃśativāriṣikī bhuktiḥ svata eva svatve pramāṇaṃ tadā tata eva sādhyasiddhau –
469 śaktasya saṃnidhāv artho yasya lekhyena bhujyate |
varṣāṇi viṃśatiṃ yāvat tatpattraṃ doṣavarjitam || [K 299]
iti kātyāyanavacanena yadbhogasya lekhyadoṣanirākaraṇārthatvam uktaṃ tad vyāhanyeta |
vastutas tu hānibodhakasmṛtīnāṃ pramāṇaparipālanakartavyatāvidhiśeṣatvam | tasmāt svapramāṇaṃ sarvathā paripālanīyaṃ na tu tatrodāsitavyam ity atra tātparyam | ata eva kalpatarau hānivacanāni likhitvā pramāṇaparipālanam upasaṃhṛtam |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
470 āgamo ‘pi balaṃ naiva bhuktistokāpi yatra no || [Y 2.27cd]
āgame vidyamāne ‘pi bhogavirahāt tāvat kālaṃ svatvānuvṛttidhīr na bhavatīty arthaḥ | yatra vādinau svasvāgamabalapravṛttau āgamayoś ca pūrvāparabhāvo na niścīyate tatra yasya bhuktis tasyāgamo balīyān na tv anyasyety artha iti mitākṣarākāraḥ |
nāradaḥ |
471 vidyamāne ‘pi likhite jīvatsv api hi sākṣiṣu |
viśeṣataḥ sthāvarāṇāṃ yan na bhuktaṃ na tat sthiram || [N 1.77]
tathā |
472 pratyakṣaparibhogāt tu svāmino dvidaśāḥ samāḥ |
ādhyādīny api jīryanti strīnarendradhanād ṛte || [N 1.82]
dvidaśāḥ samāḥ viṃśativarṣāṇi | strīnarendradhanād ṛte strīdhanarājadhane vihāya |
manuḥ |
473 yat kiṃcid daśavarṣāṇi saṃnidhau prekṣate dhanī |
bhujyamānaṃ parais tūṣṇīṃ na sa tal labdhum arhati || [M 8.147]
daśeti bhūbhinnadhanaparam |
gautamaḥ |
474 ajaḍāpogaṇḍadhanaṃ daśavarṣabhuktaṃ paraiḥ saṃnidhau bhoktuḥ | [G 12.34]
jaḍo mūrkhaḥ | pogaṇḍaḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣābhyantaravayaskaḥ,
475 bāla ā ṣodaśāj jñeyaḥ pogaṇḍaś ceti kathyate | [N 1.35cd]
iti vacanāt | evaṃ ca pravīṇasya dhanaṃ saṃnidhāv anyena bhuktam utsargato bhoktur iti jñāyata iti ratnākarādayaḥ |
manuḥ |
476 ādhiś copanidhiś cobhau na kālātyayam arhataḥ |
avahāryau bhavetāṃ tau dīrghakālam avasthitau || [M 8.145]
ādhir bandhaḥ | upanidhis tu prītyā bhogārthaṃ samarpitaṃ kṣetrādi na tu vāsanastham anākhyāyetyādismṛtilakṣitaḥ, tasya bhogānarhatvāt | na kālātyayam arhataḥ mokṣaṇakāle ādhātrupanidhātṛbhyām avaśyamokṣaṇīyāv ity arthaḥ | atra hetum āha – avahāryāv ityādinā | tau hi cirakālāvasthitau bhoktur avahāryau bhavetāṃ bhoktā ca kadācid apahared apīty arthaḥ |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
477 ṛkthibhir vā parair dravyaṃ samakṣaṃ yasya dīyate |
anyasya bhuñjataḥ paścān na sa tallabdhum arhati || [B 7.40]
478 paśyann anyasya dadataḥ kṣitiṃ yo na vicālayet |
svāmī satāpi lekhyena punas tāṃ na samāpnuyāt || [B 7.41]
tathā |
479 bhūmer abhuktir lekhyasya yathākālam adarśanam |
asmāraṇaṃ sākṣiṇāṃ ca svārthahānikarāṇi tu || [B 7.66]
480 tasmād yatnena kartavyaṃ pramāṇaparipālanam |
tena kāryāṇi sidhyanti sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || [B 7.67]
ṛkthibhir iti – yasya svāminaḥ samakṣam eva ṛkthibhir vā parair vā tadīyadhanam anyasya kṛte dīyate tasmāt saṃpradānāt tac ca dravyaṃ bhuñjānāt taddravyasvāmī tad dravyaṃ punar nāpnoti | tatra svāmina utsargataḥ svatvam apaitīty arthaḥ |
kātyāyanaḥ |
481 bhuktir balavatī śāstre saṃtatā yā cirantanī |
vicchinnāpi hi sā jñeyā yā tu pūrvaprasādhitā || [K 329]
482 ādānakālād ārabhya bhuktir yā tu nirantarā |
ādānaṃ prāpya tasyās tu prāyaḥ sākṣyaṃ pravartate || [K?]
483 smārte kāle kriyā bhūmeḥ sāgamā bhuktir iṣyate |
asmārte tv āgamābhāvāt kramāt tripuruṣāgatā || [K 321]

jñeyaṃ darśayati ādāneti – asyām alpakālāyām eva nirantarāyāṃ tathā pūrvoktāyāṃ sāntarāyām ubhayasyām api bhuktau svamūlabhūta āgame pratyāyye prāyaḥ sākṣyaṃ pramāṇatvam ity arthaḥ |
smārte iti – smārte smaraṇayogye | kriyā pramāṇam | āgamaḥ krayādiḥ | āgamābhāvāt āgamapratisaṃdhānābhāvāt | tenāyam arthaḥ – āgamasmaraṇayogye samaye sāgamā bhuktir bhūmau pramāṇam iṣyate | āgamasmaraṇāyogye tu atipātini samaye āgamapratisaṃdhānavirahitā bhuktir eva pramāṇaṃ na tv āgamābhāvaniścaye ‘pi, tatra sarvaiḥ svatvaniṣedhād iti |
atha sāgamabhukteḥ pramāṇatve vyarthaviśeṣaṇatā | na – idam idānīṃ mama svam iti hi tāvat sādhyam | tatra hi svatvabhāge āgamasya tantratā tasya tv idānīṃ paryantam anuvṛttau bhogasyeti vivekaḥ |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
484 āgamas tu kṛto yena so ‘bhiyuktas tam uddharet |
na tatsutas tatsuto vā bhiktis tatra garīyasī || [Y 2.28]
āgamo dhanopārjanopāyaḥ krayādiḥ | tatrābhiyuktasteyam uddharet likhitādinā pramāpayet | tatsutasya tu sāgamā bhuktir eva pramāṇaṃ na tv āgamapariśodhanam api tena kartavyam ity arthah |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
485 āhartā śodhayed bhuktim āgamaṃ cāpi saṃsadi |
tatsuto bhuktim ekaikāṃ tatputrādir na kiṃcana || [B 7.39]
āhartā arjanakartā |
kātyāyanaḥ |
486 yenopāttaṃ hi yad dravyaṃ so ‘bhiyuktas tad uddharet |
cirakālopabhoge ‘pi bhuktis tasyaiva neṣyate || [K 324]
arjakasya cirakālabhuktir api svāgamavibhāvanaṃ vinā na pramāṇam iṣyata ity arthaḥ |
487 yad āhartābhiyuktaḥ syāt lekhyaṃ sākṣī tadā guru |
bhoktrabhāve hi bhuktis tu sute tābhyāṃ garīyasī || [K?]
arjakaḥ svārjite pramāṇatvena lekhyādikaṃ darśayet | arjakābhāve tatsutasya lekhyādito bhuktir eva pramāṇam ity arthaḥ |
488 nopabhoge balaṃ kāryam āhartrā tatsutena vā |
paśustrīpuruṣādīnām iti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ || [K 316]
ādipadaṃ jaṅgamāntaraparam | atra ceyaṃ vyavasthā – yad arjakasyāpi lekhyasākṣivirahe pañcāṅgo bhogaḥ pramāṇam eva vākyāni tu prāyikaparatayā boddhavyāni evaṃ paśvādiṣv api kevalabhogaprāmāṇyaniṣedhaḥ prāyikaparatayaiva neyaḥ |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
489 yo ‘bhiyuktaḥ paretaḥ syāt tasya ṛkthī tam uddharet |
na tatra kāraṇaṃ bhuktir āgamena vina kṛtā || [Y 2.29]
yo bhoge kriyamāṇe eva pareṇabhiyuktaḥ kṛtāparicchedaḥ san paretaḥ mṛtaḥ tasya ṛkthī putrādiḥ tadartham āgamenoddharet sādhayet | bhuktis tatra na pramāṇaṃ pūrvābhiyogena satpratipakṣitatvād iti arthaḥ |
āgamābhāvaniścaye ‘pi ṣaṣṭyābdiko bhogaḥ svatve pramāṇam | anyāneynāpi yad bhuktaṃ pitrā pūrvatarais tribhir ityādisvarasādi iti navyāḥ | tan na – anāgamaṃ tu bhuṅkta ity atra santānāpekṣayaikavacanam iti vyācakṣāṇena pārijātakṛtā bahvabdaśatam api pitāputrakrameṇa saṃtānena bhujyamāne ‘pi vastuni bhogāt svatvam anaṅgīkurvatāsya sudūram utsāritatvād iti |
athānyabhogena hānyapavādaḥ |
tatra bṛhaspatiḥ |
490 bhuktis tripuruṣī sidhyed apareṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
anivṛtte sapiṇḍatve sakulyānāṃ na sidhyati || [B 7.43]
491 asvāminā tu yad bhuktaṃ gṛhakṣetrāpaṇādikam |

bhūmyādau viṃśativārṣiko gavādau daśavārṣiko bhogaḥ pūrvasvāminaḥ svatvadhvaṃse pramāṇam iti yatkālavaiṣamyaṃ bhūmyāder mahāphalatvenātimahattvāspadatvāt tatra cirakālenaiva svatvahānikalpanāt | tathā dravyāntarāṇāṃ cātathātvād alpakālenāpi svatvahānikalpanādyuktam | yac ca bhūmyādāv eva kālavaiṣamyena bhoktuḥ svatvajananaṃ tad api vacanabalād eva yuktaṃ yathā tad eva hi janma putrasya pitṛdhane svatvajanakaṃ na tu putryā iti |
atra pradīpakṛtaḥ – yatra hi matkṛtyedānīṃ nātra phalasaṃbhāvanā tad idānīṃ tāvat para eva bhuṅktāṃ paścād etat sakāśāt sabhogāṃ bhuvaṃ grahīṣyāmīty abhisaṃdhāya bhūsvāmī kṣamate tatrāsti viṃśatyābdiko bhogo na tu svāminas taduddeśena svabhūtyāga iti vyabhicārān nāyaṃ bhogaḥ pūrvasvāminas tu tyāge pramāṇam |

api ca tyāgāt bhoktuḥ svatvaṃ svarūpam ato jñānād vā | nādyaḥ adṛṣṭacaratvāt | dvitīye ca jñānaṃ bhoktuḥ svāmivacanādinā syāt | tathā ca taduddeśena mayedaṃ tyaktam iti tatsvāminas tadabhisaṃdhipūrvakād vacanāt tat syāt idaṃ ca dānam eveti kṛtam upekṣānusaraṇena |
