vibhāvitaikadeśena deyaṃ tad api yujyate || [N?]
idaṃ cobhayam api yeṣām arthānāṃ mitho ‘vinābhāvas tatparam, nyāyamūlakatvāt | yad vā ekadeśapramāpite sarvam eva dāsyāmīti sapaṇavivādaviṣayam idam | tad āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
731 sapaṇaś ced vivādaḥ syāt tatra hīnaṃ pradāpayet |
daṇḍaṃ ca svapaṇaṃ caiva dhanine dhanam eva ca || [Y 2.18]
svapaṇaṃ svayaṃkṛtapaṇam ity arthaḥ |
atha jayipratipattiḥ |
tatra bṛhaspatiḥ |
732 pratijñābhāvanād vādī prāḍvivākādipūjanāt |
jayapattrasya cādānāj jayī loke nigadyate || [B 9.21]
kātyāyanaḥ |
733 siddhenārthena saṃyojyo vādī satkārapūrvakam |
lekhyaṃ tadarthasaṃyuktaṃ tasmai dadyāc ca pārthivaḥ || [K 262]
tathā –
734 nirastaṃ likhitaṃ yat tu tac ca sabhyo vināśayet |
paścātkārakriyā vāpi nirasyeta na saṃśayaḥ || [K?]
735 nirastā tu kriyā yatra pramāṇenaiva vādinā |
paścātkāro bhavet tatra na sarvāsu vidhīyate || [K 264cdef]
736 dāsastrībhūgṛhārāmalekhakānāṃ parājaye |
eteṣv eva sadā deyaḥ paścātkāras tu pārthivaiḥ || [K?]
paścātkāro nirṇayānantarakriyā jayapattrādikā | pramāṇaṃ sākṣyādi | eteṣv evety upalakṣaṇam, anyatrāpi śiṣṭais taddānāt |
atha punarnyāyaḥ |
manuḥ |
737 tīritaṃ cānuśiṣṭaṃ ca yatra kvacana yad bhavet |
kṛtaṃ tad dharmato vidyāt na tad bhūyo nivartayet || [M 9.233]
tīritam iti – tīra pāra karmasamāptāv ity asya curādikasya niṣṭhāyāṃ rūpam | tena nirṇīya samāpitam ity arthaḥ | anuśiṣṭaṃ sākṣibhir uktam | yatra kvacana grāmādisabhāyām | ayaṃ tu lakṣmīdharādisvarasaḥ | granthāntare tu – sākṣyādīnāṃ duṣṭatve paraṃ vicāritasya tīritatvānuśiṣṭatve na tv anyatheti | tad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
738 asad sad iti yaḥ pakṣaḥ sabhyair evāvadhāryate |
tīritaḥ so ‘nuśiṣṭas tu sākṣidauṣṭyāt prakīrtitaḥ || [K 495]
yatra tu tīritānuśiṣṭayor apy adharmakṛtatvaṃ matvā parājayī punaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate tatra tasya svīkāritavivādaviṣayadviguṇadaṇḍasya bhūyo ‘pi nyāyadarśanaṃ kāryam evety āha nāradaḥ |
739 tīritaṃ cānuśiṣṭaṃ ca yo manyeta vidharmataḥ |
dviguṇaṃ daṇḍam āsthāya tat kāryaṃ punar uddharet || [NMā 1.65]
vidharmakṛtatvaṃ prakārakam |
svaceṣṭāvasite punarnyāyadarśanābhāvaṃ cāha sa eva |
740 sākṣisabhyāvasannānāṃ dūṣaṇe darśanaṃ punaḥ | [NMā 2.40]
svacaryāvasitānāṃ ca nāsti paunarbhavo vidhiḥ ||
sākṣisabhyāvasannānāṃ sākṣinigadena sabhyāvadhāraṇena ca prāptāvasādānāṃ punardarśanaṃ nyāyapradarśanam ity arthaḥ | dūṣaṇe sākṣiṇāṃ sabhyānāṃ ca dūṣaṇe satīty arthaḥ | svacaryāvasitānāṃ svavyāpāreṇa parasparaviruddhabhāṣaṇādinā svayam evāṅgīkṛtaparājayatvena prāptāvasādānām | nāsti paunarbhavo vidhir iti – na punarvyavahārapravartanam ity arthaḥ |
tatraiva bṛhaspatiḥ |
741 palāyanānuttaratvād anyapakṣāśrayeṇa ca |
hīnasya gṛhyate vādo na svavākyajitasya tu || [B 9.22]
idam atrāhṛtam – aduṣṭasākṣisabhyādibhiḥ darmato yad vicāritaṃ tad vādīcchāmātreṇānyathākṛtaṃ tatra dviguṇadaṇḍam āsthāpāpi na vicāryam, tīritaṃ cānuśiṣṭaṃ ceti manuvākyavirodhād anavasthāpatteḥ |
yat tu lobhapramādādinā duṣṭasākṣisabhyair nirṇītaṃ tatra dūṣaṇe pramāṇasiddhe punar vicāraṇīyam eva | yad āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
742 durdṛṣṭāṃs tu punar dṛṣṭvā vyavahārān nṛpeṇa tu |
sabhyāḥ sajayino daṇḍyā vivādād dviguṇaṃ damam || [Y 2.305]
nārado ‘pi |
743 asākṣikaṃ tu yad dṛṣṭaṃ vimārgeṇa ca tīritam |
asaṃmatamatair dṛṣṭaṃ punar darśanam arhati || [NQ 1.14]
tathā –
744 niścitya bahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ bāhmaṇaiḥ śāstrapāragaiḥ |
daṇḍayej jayinā sākaṃ pūrvasabhyāṃs tu doṣiṇaḥ || [B 9.24]
sabhyān ity anena sākṣiṇo ‘py upalakṣyāḥ |
yājñavalkyo ‘pi |
745 balopadhivinirvṛttān vyavahārān nivartayet | iti | [Y 2.31ab]
tataś ca yan nirṇītam api sākṣisabhyādidurlakṣyadūṣaṇam udbhāvya parājito vādī na svīkaroti kiṃ tu punarvicāram arthayate tatra dviguṇadaṇḍam āsthāya dūṣaṇam evāpātato vicāraṇīyam | siddhe ca dūṣaṇe dviguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ tiraskṛtya punas tattvato vivādapadavicāra eva pravartanīyaḥ |
746 durdṛṣṭāṃs tu punar dṛṣṭvā vyavahārān nṛpeṇa tu | [Y 2.305ab]
iti likhitayājñavalkyasvarasād eva dūṣaṇasiddhipākṣe tu vādināṅgīkṛtaṃ dviguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ sabhyā dāpyāḥ | atiprasaktivāraṇasya rājñā avaśyakartavyatvāt | yad āha nāradaḥ |
747 durdṛṣṭe vyavahāre tu sabhyās taṃ daṇḍam āpnuyuḥ |
na hi jātu vinā daṇḍaṃ kaścin mārge ‘vatiṣṭhate || iti | [NMā 1.66]
tena tat kāryaṃ punar uddhared ity asya parājitasākṣisabhyādidūṣaṇaṃ tattvato vicārya punar vyavahāraṃ pravartayed ity arthaḥ | yuktaṃ cedaṃ tīritānuśiṣṭayoś ca sabhyasākṣikartṛkayor vidharmakṛtatvaṃ tayor eva dūṣaṇaparaṃ nānyathā | atas tattvanirūpaṇam evocitam |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
748 yo manyetājito ‘smīti nyāyenāpi parājitaḥ |
sabhāyāṃ tu punar jitvā dāpayed dviguṇaṃ damam || [Y 2.306]
tattvataḥ parājito ‘pi tāttvikasākṣyādidoṣam āśaṅkya vicārasyāsamyaktvaṃ manvānas taddoṣaṃ nirūpyāsattvenāvadhārya vivādapadād dhanād dviguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpya ity arthaḥ |
amātyaprāḍvivākayos tu duṣṭatve na dviguṇo daṇḍaḥ | kiṃ tarhi sahasram ity āha manuḥ |
749 amātyāḥ prāḍvivākā vā ye kuryuḥ kāryam anyathā |
tat svayaṃ nṛpatiḥ kuryāt tān sahasraṃ tu dāpayet || [M 9.234]]
sahasraṃ paṇānām –
750 paṇānāṃ dviśatāni | [Vi 4.14a]
iti viṣṇuvacanāt |
tad ayaṃ saṃkṣepaḥ – pūrvavicārasyāsamyaktvaśaṅkāyām eva punarvicāraḥ | tatrāpi parājitasyādau dviguṇadaṇḍasvīkāraḥ | tato vicārapravṛttau svoktasya sākṣyādidūṣaṇasya tena pūraṇe sākṣyādimātradaṇḍaḥ vivādapadasya punarvicāraṇaṃ ca | apūraṇe tu parājitasyaiva daṇḍo na tu vicārāntaram apīti |
atha kṛtanivṛttiḥ |
tatra manuḥ |
751 yasmin yasmin vivāde tu kauṭasākṣyaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet |
tat tat kāryaṃ nivarteta kṛtam apy akṛtaṃ bhavet || [M 8.117]
752 yogādhamanavikrītaṃ yogadānapratigraham |
yatra vāpy upadhiṃ paśyet tat kāryaṃ vinivartayet || [M 8.165]
yogaḥ dhadma | tena yad bandhakārpaṇādi kṛtaṃ tad rājā nivartayed ity arthaḥ | upadhiṃ chalam | atrādhamanādikam upalakṣaṇam | tato ‘nyad api nivartyam |
yogo viśrambhāghātī tat kṛtaṃ vikrayādi nivartayed ity artha iti halāyudhaḥ |
tathā –
753 balād dattaṃ balād bhuktaṃ balād yac cāpi lekhitam |
sarvān balakṛtān arthān akṛtān manur abravīt || [M 8.168]
nāradaḥ |
754 strīṣu rātrau bahir grāmād antarveśmany arātiṣu |
vyavahāraḥ kṛto ‘py eṣu punaḥ kartavyatām iyāt || [NMā 1.43]
tathā –
755 satyā na bhāṣā bhavati yady api syāt pratiṣṭhitā |
bahiś cet bhāṣate dharmān niyatād vyavahārikāt || [NMā 2.15]
yā niyatavyavahārikadharmabāhyaviṣayā bhāṣocyate sā pratiṣṭhitāpi lekhyādipramāṇavaty api satyā na bhavati | tayā yo ‘rthaḥ pratipādyate asau nānuṣṭheyo yathā putrādimantaṃ kaścid abhiyuṅkte anena sarvasvaṃ mama dattam ityādi |
manuḥ |
756 mattonmattādhyadhīnaiś ca bālena sthavireṇa vā |
asaṃbaddhakṛtaś caiva vyavahāro na sidhyati || [M 8.163]
adhyadhīno dāsaḥ | asambaddho ‘nadhikārī |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
757 balopadhivinirvṛttān vyavahārān nivartayet |
strīnakamantarāgārabahiḥśatrukṛtāṃs tathā || [2.31]
bahir vyavahārocitapradeśāt |
nāradaḥ |
758 yad bālaḥ kurute kāryam asvatantras tathaiva ca |
akṛtaṃ tad api prāhuḥ śāstre śāstravido janāḥ || [N 1.39]
759 svatantro ‘pi hi yat kāryaṃ kuryād aprakṛtiṃ gataḥ |
tad apy akṛtam evāhur asvatantraḥ sa hetubhiḥ || [N 1.40]
760 kāmakrodhābhibhūtānāṃ bhayavyasanapīḍitāḥ |
rāgadveṣaparītāś ca jñeyās tv aprakṛtiṃ gatāḥ || [N 1.41]
761 tathā dāsakṛtaṃ kāryam akṛtaṃ paricakṣate |
anyatra svāmisaṃdeśāt na dāsaḥ prabhur ātmanaḥ || [N 1.29]
762 putreṇa ca kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ yas syād acchandataḥ pituḥ |
tad apy akṛtam evāhur dāsaḥ putraś ca tau samau || [N 1.30]
asvatantragrahaṇāl labdhe ‘pi bāle punar bālagrahaṇaṃ pitror abhāve ‘pi bālasyāsvātantryapratipādanārtham | etac ca kuṭumbabharaṇātiriktaparam, kuṭumbārthaṃ ‘dhyadhīno ‘pīty agrimavākyāt |
prakṛtiḥ svabhāvaḥ | aprakṛtiṃ gataḥ asvabhāvastha ity arthaḥ |
acchandata iti pituś chandaṃ icchāṃ vinety arthaḥ |
kātyāyanaḥ |
763 na kṣetrgṛhadāsānāṃ dānādhamanavikrayāḥ |
asvatantrakṛtāḥ siddhiṃ prāpnuyur nānuvarṇitāḥ || [K 467]
nānuvarṇitā ananumatāḥ | svatantreṇeti śeṣaḥ |
nāradaḥ |
764 strīkṛtāny apramāṇāni kāryāṇy āhur anāpadi |
viśeṣato gṛhakṣetradānādhamanavikrayāḥ || [N 1.26]
765 etāny eva pramāṇāni bhartā yady anumanyate |
putraḥ patyur abhāve vā rājā vā patiputrayoḥ || [N 1.27]
766 kule jyeṣṭhas tathā śreṣṭhaḥ prakṛtisthaś ca yo bhavet |
tatkṛtaṃ syāt kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ nāsvatantrakṛtaṃ kṛtam || [N 1.42]
anāpadīty anenāpatpratīkārārthaṃ strīkṛtāny api pramāṇāny evety uktam | patiputrayor abhāva ity atra putrapadena sapatnīputro ‘py upalakṣyate | tena teṣām abhāve rājeti mantavyam |
atha svatantrāsvatantralakṣaṇam |
tatra nāradaḥ |
767 svātantryaṃ tu smṛtaṃ jyeṣṭhe jyaiṣṭhyaṃ gunavayaḥkṛtam || [N 1.31cd]
tathā –
768 asvatantrāḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ svatantraḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ|
asvatantraḥ smṛtaḥ śiṣyaḥ ācārye tu svatantratā || [N 1.33]
769 asvatantrāḥ striyaḥ sarvāḥ putrā dāsāḥ parigrahaḥ |
svatantras tatra tu gṛhī yasya tat syāt kramāgatam || [N 1.34]
770 garbhasthaiḥ sadṛśo jñeya āṣṭamād vatsarāc chiśuḥ |
bāla ā ṣoḍaśād varṣāt pogaṇḍaś cāpi gadyate || [N 1.35]
771 parato vyavahārajñaḥ svatantraḥ pitarāv ṛte |
jīvator na svatantraḥ syāt jarayāpi samanvitaḥ || [N 1.36]
772 tayor api pitā śreyān bījaprādhānyadarśanāt |
abhāve bījino mātā tadabhāve tu pūrvajaḥ || [N 1.37]
tayoḥ pitroḥ |
etac ca svātantryāsvātantryapratipādanaṃ svatantrānumatiṃ vinā paratantreṇa kṛtam api rājñā nivartanīyam iti pratipādayituṃ na tv adṛṣṭārtham, kṛtanivṛttisaṃdaṃśa eva nāradena likhanāt | etad eva spaṣṭayati sa eva |
773 svatantrāḥ sarva evaite paratantreṣu nityaśaḥ |
anuśiṣṭau visarge ca vikraye ceśvarā matā || iti | [N 1.38]
ete rājādayaḥ pūrvoktāḥ |
tadabhāve ca pūrvaja iti vacanāt pitarāv ṛte ity atra pūrvajādikaṃ vināpīti mantavyam |
abhāve bījino mātety anena mātuḥ svātantryam asvātantryaṃ ca putrasyeti pratipāditaṃ yady api tathāpi putraḥ patyur abhāveti nāradasvarasād asvatantrasyāpi putrasyānumatim antareṇa svatantrayāpi mātrā anāpatkāle yat kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ tan nivartanīyam eva | na caivaṃ putrānumatir adṛṣṭārthā syād iti vācyam | pitṛparokṣe taddhanasya putragāmitvena tadanumater dṛṣṭārthatvasaṃbhavāt |
śaṅkhalikhitau |
774 asvatantrāḥ pitṛmantaḥ || [ŚL?]
pitāmahe jīvati pitari putravat pāratantryam | tataś ca pitāmahānumatyā pitṛkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ sidhyati nānyathā |
kaniṣṭho ‘pi bhrāta avibhaktadhana eva jyeṣṭhāpekṣayā paratantro na tu vibhaktadhano ‘pīty āha kātyāyanaḥ |
775 pitāsvatantraḥ pitṛmān bhrāta bhrātṛvya eva vā |
kaniṣṭho vāvibhaktasvo dāsaḥ karmakaras tathā || [K 466]
hārītaḥ |
776 dānārthe vā dhanārthe va dharmārthe vā viśeṣataḥ |
ādāne vā visarge vā na strī svātantryam arhati || [H 2.15]
kvacit kārye asvatantrā api te pramāṇam ity āha kātyāyanaḥ |
777 pramāṇaṃ sarva evaite paṇyānāṃ krayavikraye |
yadi saṃvyavahāraṃ prāk kurvanto hy anumoditāḥ || [K 468]
778 kṣetrādīnāṃ tathaiva syur bhrātā bhrātṛsutaḥ sutaḥ |
nisṛṣṭāḥ kṛtyakāraṇe guruṇā yadi gacchatā || [K 469]
779 nisṛṣṭārthas tu yo yasmin tasminn arthe prabhus tu saḥ |
tadbhartā tatkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ nanyathā kartum arhati || K 470]
nisṛṣṭārthaṃ vivṛṇoti bṛhaspatiḥ |
780 yaḥ svāminā niyuktas tu dhanāyavyayapalane |
kusīdakṛṣivāṇijye nisṛṣṭārthas tu sa smṛtaḥ || [B 9.29]
781 pramāṇaṃ tatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ lābhālābhavyayodayam |
svadeśe vā videśe vā svāmī tan na visaṃvadet || [B 9.28]
manuḥ |
782 kuṭumbārthe ‘dhadhīno ‘pi vyavahāraṃ samācaret |
svadeśe vā videśe vā taṃ jyāyān na vicālayet || [M 8.167]
adhyadhīnaḥ paratantraḥ putradāsādiḥ | samācaret kuryāt | tadṛśārthe svāmyanumatyapekṣāpi neti bhāvaḥ | jyāyān svatantraḥ pitrādiḥ |
kātyāyanaḥ |

vikraye caiva dāne ca vaśitvaṃ na sute pituḥ || [K 471]
